```{r}
# ============================================================================
# Feature Transformation
# ============================================================================

# -----------------------------
# Robust Feature Transformation
# -----------------------------
cat("\n=== Feature Transformation (full robust version) ===\n")

# work on a copy
data_transformed <- data_clean

# -----------------------------
# 1) Robust salary_range mapping
# -----------------------------
cat("\n1) Converting salary_range to ordered factor (robust)...\n")

map_salary_to_level <- function(x) {
  if(is.na(x) || trimws(as.character(x)) == "") return(NA_integer_)
  s <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  # remove euro sign, keep digits, k, plus sign, hyphen and spaces
  s2 <- gsub("€", "", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s2 <- gsub("\\s+", " ", s2)
  # remove other characters except digits, k, +, -, space
  s2 <- gsub("[^0-9kK+ \\-]", "", s2)
  s2 <- trimws(s2)
  
  # direct patterns
  if(grepl("60\\+|60k\\+|>=60|>= 60", s2, ignore.case = TRUE)) return(4L)
  if(grepl("40.*-.*60|40k.*-.*60k|40.*-.*60k|40k.*-.*60", s2, ignore.case = TRUE)) return(3L)
  if(grepl("20.*-.*40|20k.*-.*40k|20.*-.*40k|20k.*-.*40", s2, ignore.case = TRUE)) return(2L)
  if(grepl("0.*-.*20|0-20|<20|< 20|under 20|less than 20|0k.*-.*20k", s2, ignore.case = TRUE)) return(1L)
  
  # fallback: extract first number and use thresholds
  nums <- unlist(regmatches(s2, gregexpr("[0-9]+", s2)))
  if(length(nums) > 0) {
    n <- as.numeric(nums[1])
    if(!is.na(n)) {
      if(n >= 60) return(4L)
      if(n >= 40) return(3L)
      if(n >= 20) return(2L)
      return(1L)
    }
  }
  # else unknown
  return(NA_integer_)
}

# apply mapping safely (vectorized)
data_transformed$salary_range_level <- vapply(data_transformed$salary_range, map_salary_to_level, integer(1))

# convert to ordered factor with labels
salary_labels <- c("0-20K", "20-40K", "40-60K", "60K+")
data_transformed$salary_range <- factor(data_transformed$salary_range_level,
                                        levels = 1:4,
                                        labels = salary_labels,
                                        ordered = TRUE)

cat("   Salary range distribution (after mapping):\n")
print(table(data_transformed$salary_range, useNA = "ifany"))

# show rows that failed mapping (optional)
bad_sr_idx <- which(is.na(data_transformed$salary_range_level) & !is.na(data_transformed$salary_range))
if(length(bad_sr_idx) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\n   Warning: %d rows had unmapped salary_range values. Showing up to 10 examples:\n", length(bad_sr_idx)))
  print(unique(head(data_transformed$salary_range[bad_sr_idx], 10)))
}

# -----------------------------
# 2) repaid_loan_on_prev_car -> binary 0/1
# -----------------------------
cat("\n2) Converting repaid_loan_on_prev_car to binary (0/1)...\n")

convert_to_binary <- function(x) {
  if(is.na(x)) return(NA_integer_)
  if(is.logical(x)) return(as.integer(x))
  sx <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  if(sx %in% c("true","t","yes","y","1")) return(1L)
  if(sx %in% c("false","f","no","n","0")) return(0L)
  if(grepl("^[0-9]+$", sx)) {
    v <- as.numeric(sx)
    return(as.integer(ifelse(v == 0, 0, 1)))
  }
  return(NA_integer_)
}

data_transformed$repaid_loan_on_prev_car <- vapply(data_transformed$repaid_loan_on_prev_car, convert_to_binary, integer(1))
cat("   Previous loan repayment distribution:\n")
print(table(data_transformed$repaid_loan_on_prev_car, useNA = "ifany"))

# -----------------------------
# 3) Target variable 'repaid' -> factor
# -----------------------------
cat("\n3) Normalizing target variable 'repaid' to factor...\n")
if(is.numeric(data_transformed$repaid) || is.integer(data_transformed$repaid)) {
  data_transformed$repaid <- factor(ifelse(data_transformed$repaid == 1, "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"),
                                   levels = c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid"))
} else {
  tmp <- tolower(trimws(as.character(data_transformed$repaid)))
  data_transformed$repaid <- factor(ifelse(tmp %in% c("1","repaid","yes","y","true"), "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"),
                                   levels = c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid"))
}
cat("   Target distribution:\n")
print(table(data_transformed$repaid, useNA = "ifany"))
cat(sprintf("   Repayment rate: %.2f%%\n", mean(data_transformed$repaid == "Repaid", na.rm = TRUE) * 100))

# -----------------------------
# 4) Ensure numeric types for numerical features & outlier detection
# -----------------------------
cat("\n4) Outlier detection for numerical variables...\n")
numerical_vars <- c("car_value", "debt_to_income_ratio", "loan_length")

for(var in numerical_vars) {
  if(!var %in% colnames(data_transformed)) {
    cat(sprintf("   - %s not found in data, skipping.\n", var)); next
  }
  vec <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(data_transformed[[var]]))
  q1 <- quantile(vec, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  q3 <- quantile(vec, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr <- q3 - q1
  lower_bound <- q1 - 1.5 * iqr
  upper_bound <- q3 + 1.5 * iqr
  outliers <- sum(vec < lower_bound | vec > upper_bound, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("   %s: %d outliers (%.2f%%)\n",
              var, outliers, outliers / nrow(data_transformed) * 100))
}

cat("\n✓ Feature transformation complete\n")


```


```{r}
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== Feature Scaling ===\n")

# Create a copy for scaling
data_scaled <- data_transformed

# Identify numerical columns to scale

cat("\nScaling numerical features:\n")

# Store scaling parameters
scaling_params <- list()

for(col in numeric_cols) {
  # Calculate mean and sd
  col_mean <- mean(data_scaled[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  col_sd <- sd(data_scaled[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Store parameters
  scaling_params[[col]] <- list(mean = col_mean, sd = col_sd)
  
  # Scale the column
  data_scaled[[col]] <- scale(data_scaled[[col]])
  
  cat(sprintf("  %s: mean=%.2f, sd=%.2f\n", col, col_mean, col_sd))
}

cat("\n✓ Feature scaling complete\n")
```

5. Model Training
5.1 Logistic Regression

```{r}
# STEP5_logistic_regression_fixed.R
# Robust Logistic Regression step (caret::glm) — fixes contrasts/single-level factor issues
# - Uses fixed 5 Phase-1 features
# - CV fixed at 10-fold (printed)
# - Prints & saves train/test sizes and metrics

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(caret)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(pROC)
  library(ggplot2)
})

set.seed(42)

# === CONFIG ===
OUT_DIR <- file.path(getwd(), "model_lr_outputs")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# fixed Phase-1 5 features
FEATURES <- c(
  "car_value",
  "salary_range",
  "debt_to_income_ratio",
  "loan_length",
  "repaid_loan_on_prev_car"
)

# CV config
CV_FOLDS <- 10

# === PRECHECKS ===
if (!exists("train_data") || !exists("test_data")) {
  stop("train_data and test_data must exist in the environment. If you have data_final, create train/test first.")
}
if (!"repaid" %in% names(train_data)) stop("'train_data' must contain a 'repaid' column.")
if (!"repaid" %in% names(test_data))  stop("'test_data' must contain a 'repaid' column.")

message("STEP 5: Logistic Regression (fixed handling for single-level factors) — starting")
message(sprintf("Using FEATURES: %s", paste(FEATURES, collapse = ", ")))
message(sprintf("CV folds: %d", CV_FOLDS))

# === Subset to the 5 features + target (fail early if missing) ===
miss_train <- setdiff(FEATURES, names(train_data))
miss_test  <- setdiff(FEATURES, names(test_data))
if (length(miss_train) > 0) stop("train_data missing required feature(s): ", paste(miss_train, collapse = ", "))
if (length(miss_test)  > 0) stop("test_data  missing required feature(s): ", paste(miss_test, collapse = ", "))

# Keep only selected features + target (makes processing simpler and deterministic)
train_data <- train_data[, c(FEATURES, "repaid")]
test_data  <- test_data[,  c(FEATURES, "repaid")]

message(sprintf("After subsetting, train rows: %d, test rows: %d", nrow(train_data), nrow(test_data)))

# === Helper: coerce response to factor with levels Not_Repaid / Repaid ===
coerce_response <- function(v) {
  vc <- as.character(v)
  vc[is.na(vc)] <- NA_character_
  lc <- tolower(trimws(vc))
  lc[lc %in% c("0","false","no","n","notrepaid","not_repaid","not repaid","nope")] <- "Not_Repaid"
  lc[lc %in% c("1","true","yes","y","repaid","paid","ok","paid")] <- "Repaid"
  vc[] <- lc
  u <- unique(na.omit(vc))
  if (length(u) != 2) {
    stop("Response must have two classes (after coercion). Found: ", paste(u, collapse = ", "))
  }
  factor(vc, levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
}

# drop training rows with NA target (safer)
if (any(is.na(train_data$repaid))) {
  warning("Dropping rows in train_data with NA target")
  train_data <- train_data[!is.na(train_data$repaid), , drop = FALSE]
}

# coerce train target to canonical factor
train_data$repaid <- coerce_response(train_data$repaid)

# For test, coerce labels where possible but keep NA if unknown
test_data$repaid <- as.character(test_data$repaid)
test_data$repaid[tolower(test_data$repaid) %in% c("0","false","no","n","notrepaid","not_repaid","not repaid","nope")] <- "Not_Repaid"
test_data$repaid[tolower(test_data$repaid) %in% c("1","true","yes","y","repaid","paid","ok","paid")] <- "Repaid"
# keep as character/NA for alignment later

# === Impute and align predictors ===
# Numeric median impute from train -> apply to test
num_cols <- names(train_data)[sapply(train_data, is.numeric)]
num_cols <- setdiff(num_cols, "repaid")
medians <- list()
for (cn in num_cols) {
  med <- median(train_data[[cn]], na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(med)) med <- 0
  medians[[cn]] <- med
  train_data[[cn]][is.na(train_data[[cn]])] <- med
  if (cn %in% names(test_data) && is.numeric(test_data[[cn]])) {
    test_data[[cn]][is.na(test_data[[cn]])] <- med
  }
}

# Categorical: fill NA -> "Missing" and align levels (train -> test)
cat_cols <- names(train_data)[sapply(train_data, function(x) is.factor(x) || is.character(x))]
cat_cols <- setdiff(cat_cols, "repaid")
for (cn in cat_cols) {
  train_data[[cn]] <- as.character(train_data[[cn]])
  train_data[[cn]][is.na(train_data[[cn]])] <- "Missing"
  train_levels <- unique(train_data[[cn]])
  train_levels <- c(setdiff(train_levels, "Missing"), "Missing")
  train_data[[cn]] <- factor(train_data[[cn]], levels = train_levels)
  if (cn %in% names(test_data)) {
    test_data[[cn]] <- as.character(test_data[[cn]])
    test_data[[cn]][is.na(test_data[[cn]])] <- "Missing"
    unseen <- setdiff(unique(test_data[[cn]]), train_levels)
    final_levels <- c(train_levels, setdiff(unseen, "Missing"))
    test_data[[cn]] <- factor(test_data[[cn]], levels = final_levels)
  }
}

# === Detect and remove single-level predictors (causes contrasts/dummy failures) ===
predictors <- setdiff(names(train_data), "repaid")
single_level_cols <- c()
for (p in predictors) {
  uvals <- unique(na.omit(as.character(train_data[[p]])))
  if (length(uvals) <= 1) single_level_cols <- c(single_level_cols, p)
}
if (length(single_level_cols) > 0) {
  message("Removing single-level predictors (present in training only one unique value): ",
          paste(single_level_cols, collapse = ", "))
  predictors <- setdiff(predictors, single_level_cols)
  train_data <- train_data[, c(predictors, "repaid"), drop = FALSE]
  test_data  <- test_data[, c(intersect(names(test_data), predictors), "repaid"), drop = FALSE]
}

# After removal re-evaluate cat/num lists
predictors <- setdiff(names(train_data), "repaid")
if (length(predictors) == 0) stop("No predictors remain after removing single-level variables.")
num_cols <- predictors[sapply(train_data[predictors], is.numeric)]
cat_cols <- setdiff(predictors, num_cols)

# === Prepare design for GLM: dummyVars (fullRank=TRUE) to avoid contrasts issues ===
formula_str <- paste("~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))
dv <- dummyVars(formula_str, data = train_data, fullRank = TRUE)

train_x <- predict(dv, newdata = train_data)
test_x  <- predict(dv, newdata = test_data)

train_lr_df <- as.data.frame(train_x, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
train_lr_df$repaid <- train_data$repaid

test_lr_df <- as.data.frame(test_x, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if ("repaid" %in% names(test_data)) {
  test_lr_df$repaid <- factor(test_data$repaid, levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
}

# Remove zero-variance / near-zero-variance columns
nzv <- nearZeroVar(train_lr_df %>% select(-repaid), saveMetrics = TRUE)
if (any(nzv$nzv)) {
  drop_cols <- rownames(nzv)[nzv$nzv]
  message("Dropping near-zero-variance columns: ", paste(drop_cols, collapse = ", "))
  train_lr_df <- train_lr_df %>% select(-all_of(drop_cols))
  test_lr_df  <- test_lr_df  %>% select(-all_of(drop_cols))
}

# Ensure no remaining NA in predictors for glm
if (any(is.na(train_lr_df))) {
  na_counts <- colSums(is.na(train_lr_df))
  na_cols <- names(na_counts)[na_counts > 0]
  stop("NA values remain in train design matrix (cols): ", paste(na_cols, collapse = ", "),
       "\nPlease inspect imputation or predictor types.")
}

# === trainControl and model training (CV folds printed) ===
train_control <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = CV_FOLDS,
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
  savePredictions = "final",
  verboseIter = FALSE
)

message(sprintf("\nTraining Logistic Regression with %d-fold CV (metric = ROC)...", CV_FOLDS))
set.seed(42)
lr_fit <- tryCatch({
  train(repaid ~ ., data = train_lr_df,
        method = "glm",
        family = "binomial",
        trControl = train_control,
        metric = "ROC",
        preProcess = c("center", "scale"))
}, error = function(e) {
  stop("Training failed: ", e$message)
})

# === Output summaries ===
message("\n=== Logistic Regression Summary (final glm) ===")
print(summary(lr_fit$finalModel))

message("\n=== CV Results ===")
print(lr_fit$results)

# variable importance (caret's varImp works for glm)
message("\n=== Variable importance (top 20) ===")
vi <- tryCatch(varImp(lr_fit, scale = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(vi)) {
  vi_df <- as.data.frame(vi$importance)
  vi_df$Feature <- rownames(vi_df)
  # safe choose importance column
  imp_col <- intersect(c("Overall","Overall"), colnames(vi_df))
  if (!"Overall" %in% colnames(vi_df)) {
    numeric_cols <- names(vi_df)[sapply(vi_df, is.numeric)]
    if (length(numeric_cols) > 0) imp_col <- numeric_cols[1] else imp_col <- NULL
  } else imp_col <- "Overall"
  if (!is.null(imp_col)) {
    vi_df <- vi_df %>% arrange(desc(.data[[imp_col]]))
    # rename chosen column to Overall if needed for consistent CSV
    if (imp_col != "Overall") names(vi_df)[names(vi_df) == imp_col] <- "Overall"
  }
  print(head(vi_df, 20))
  write.csv(vi_df, file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_varimp.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  message("varImp not available for this model.")
}

# === Predictions on test set ===
message("\nPredicting on test set...")
lr_pred_prob <- predict(lr_fit, newdata = test_lr_df, type = "prob")
lr_pred_class <- predict(lr_fit, newdata = test_lr_df, type = "raw")

# If test actual present, compute metrics
if ("repaid" %in% names(test_lr_df) && !all(is.na(test_lr_df$repaid))) {
  actual_test <- test_lr_df$repaid
  cm <- confusionMatrix(lr_pred_class, actual_test, positive = "Repaid")
  message("\n=== Test set performance ===")
  cat(sprintf("Accuracy:  %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"])))
  cat(sprintf("Sensitivity: %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"])))
  cat(sprintf("Specificity: %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm$byClass["Specificity"])))
  cat(sprintf("Precision: %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm$byClass["Precision"])))
  cat(sprintf("F1: %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"])))

  # ROC / AUC
  prob_vec <- NULL
  if (is.data.frame(lr_pred_prob) && "Repaid" %in% colnames(lr_pred_prob)) {
    prob_vec <- as.numeric(lr_pred_prob[,"Repaid"])
  } else if (is.numeric(lr_pred_prob)) {
    prob_vec <- as.numeric(lr_pred_prob)
  }
  auc_val <- NA
  if (!is.null(prob_vec) && length(prob_vec) == length(actual_test)) {
    roc_obj <- tryCatch(roc(response = as.numeric(actual_test == "Repaid"), predictor = prob_vec, quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(roc_obj)) {
      auc_val <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
      cat(sprintf("ROC-AUC: %.6f\n", auc_val))
      # save ROC plot
      png(file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_roc.png"), width = 800, height = 600)
      plot(roc_obj, main = sprintf("Logistic Regression ROC (AUC=%.4f)", auc_val))
      dev.off()
      message("Saved ROC plot to: ", file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_roc.png"))
    }
  } else {
    message("Probability vector not available or length mismatch; ROC not computed.")
  }
  message("\nConfusion matrix (test):")
  print(cm$table)
} else {
  message("No test labels available to compute performance metrics.")
}

# === Also produce & save TRAIN set metrics/predictions ===
message("\nPredicting on TRAIN set for detailed metrics...")
train_pred_prob <- predict(lr_fit, newdata = train_lr_df, type = "prob")
train_pred_class <- predict(lr_fit, newdata = train_lr_df, type = "raw")

# prepare prob vector for train
prob_train_vec <- NA_real_
if (is.data.frame(train_pred_prob) && "Repaid" %in% colnames(train_pred_prob)) {
  prob_train_vec <- as.numeric(train_pred_prob[ , "Repaid"])
} else if (is.numeric(train_pred_prob) && length(train_pred_prob) == nrow(train_lr_df)) {
  prob_train_vec <- as.numeric(train_pred_prob)
}

# ensure actual labels present in train_lr_df
actual_train <- factor(as.character(train_lr_df$repaid), levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
pred_train  <- factor(as.character(train_pred_class), levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))

cm_train <- caret::confusionMatrix(pred_train, actual_train, positive = "Repaid")

cat("\n=== TRAIN set performance ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Train rows: %d\n", nrow(train_lr_df)))
cat(sprintf("Accuracy:  %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm_train$overall["Accuracy"])))
cat(sprintf("Sensitivity: %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm_train$byClass["Sensitivity"])))
cat(sprintf("Specificity: %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm_train$byClass["Specificity"])))
cat(sprintf("Precision: %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm_train$byClass["Precision"])))
cat(sprintf("F1: %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm_train$byClass["F1"])))

# ROC / AUC on train (if possible)
auc_train <- NA_real_
if (!all(is.na(prob_train_vec)) && length(prob_train_vec) == length(actual_train)) {
  roc_train_obj <- tryCatch(pROC::roc(response = as.numeric(actual_train == "Repaid"),
                                     predictor = prob_train_vec, quiet = TRUE),
                            error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(roc_train_obj)) {
    auc_train <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_train_obj))
    cat(sprintf("ROC-AUC (train): %.6f\n", auc_train))
    # save ROC plot
    png(file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_roc_train.png"), width = 800, height = 600)
    plot(roc_train_obj, main = sprintf("Logistic Regression ROC (Train AUC=%.4f)", auc_train))
    dev.off()
    message("Saved train ROC plot to: ", file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_roc_train.png"))
  } else {
    cat("ROC on train could not be computed (error building roc object).\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Probability vector for train not available or length mismatch; ROC not computed for train.\n")
}

cat("\nConfusion matrix (train):\n")
print(cm_train$table)

# Save train predictions (prefer original train_data if present)
train_out <- train_data
train_out$pred_class <- as.character(train_pred_class)
train_out$prob_Repaid <- if (is.data.frame(train_pred_prob) && "Repaid" %in% colnames(train_pred_prob)) as.numeric(train_pred_prob[,"Repaid"]) else NA_real_

train_preds_file <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "train_data_with_preds.csv")
write.csv(train_out, train_preds_file, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved train predictions to:", train_preds_file, "\n")

# Save test predictions
test_out <- test_data
test_out$pred_class <- as.character(lr_pred_class)
test_out$prob_Repaid <- if (is.data.frame(lr_pred_prob) && "Repaid" %in% colnames(lr_pred_prob)) as.numeric(lr_pred_prob[,"Repaid"]) else NA_real_
test_preds_file <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "test_data_with_preds.csv")
write.csv(test_out, test_preds_file, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved test predictions to:", test_preds_file, "\n")

# === Save numeric metrics to CSV (train & test) ===
metrics_train_df <- data.frame(
  Set = "TRAIN",
  Accuracy = as.numeric(cm_train$overall["Accuracy"]),
  Sensitivity = as.numeric(cm_train$byClass["Sensitivity"]),
  Specificity = as.numeric(cm_train$byClass["Specificity"]),
  Precision = as.numeric(cm_train$byClass["Precision"]),
  F1 = as.numeric(cm_train$byClass["F1"]),
  ROC_AUC = ifelse(is.na(auc_train), NA_real_, auc_train),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

metrics_test_df <- data.frame(
  Set = "TEST",
  Accuracy = if ("repaid" %in% names(test_lr_df) && exists("cm")) as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"]) else NA_real_,
  Sensitivity = if ("repaid" %in% names(test_lr_df) && exists("cm")) as.numeric(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]) else NA_real_,
  Specificity = if ("repaid" %in% names(test_lr_df) && exists("cm")) as.numeric(cm$byClass["Specificity"]) else NA_real_,
  Precision = if ("repaid" %in% names(test_lr_df) && exists("cm")) as.numeric(cm$byClass["Precision"]) else NA_real_,
  F1 = if ("repaid" %in% names(test_lr_df) && exists("cm")) as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"]) else NA_real_,
  ROC_AUC = ifelse(exists("auc_val") && !is.na(auc_val), auc_val, NA_real_),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

metrics_all <- bind_rows(metrics_train_df, metrics_test_df)
write.csv(metrics_all, file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_train_test_metrics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved train/test numeric metrics to:", file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_train_test_metrics.csv"), "\n")

# === Save model & predictions artifact ===
message("\nSaving artifacts...")
saveRDS(lr_fit, file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_fit_caret.rds"))
write.csv(data.frame(pred_class = as.character(lr_pred_class),
                     prob_Repaid = if (is.data.frame(lr_pred_prob) && "Repaid" %in% colnames(lr_pred_prob)) as.numeric(lr_pred_prob[,"Repaid"]) else NA,
                     actual = if ("repaid" %in% names(test_lr_df)) as.character(test_lr_df$repaid) else NA),
          file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_test_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
message("Saved model and predictions to: ", normalizePath(OUT_DIR))

message("\nSTEP 5 (Logistic Regression) complete.")
```

5.2 Random Forest
```{r}
# rf_phase1_complete_cv10_safe.R
# Robust Random Forest pipeline for Phase-1 (5 features)
# - Auto-detect dataset in environment (prefers transformed/scaled/work/clean/raw/data)
# - Stratified 70/30 split, CV = 10 folds
# - Saves model, varimp CSV, train/test preds, ROC PNGs, metrics CSV
# - Prints detailed info to console

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(caret)
  library(randomForest)
  library(pROC)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
})

set.seed(42)

# ---------------- CONFIG ----------------
OUT_DIR <- file.path(getwd(), "rf_phase1_outputs_cv10")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

FEATURES <- c("car_value", "salary_range", "debt_to_income_ratio", "loan_length", "repaid_loan_on_prev_car")
TARGET <- "repaid"
TRAIN_PROP <- 0.7
NTREE <- 100
CV_FOLDS <- 10

# ---------------- AUTO-DETECT DATASET ----------------
candidate_names <- c("data_transformed", "data_scaled", "data_work", "data_clean", "data_raw", "data")
found_name <- NULL
for (nm in candidate_names) {
  if (exists(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    obj <- get(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    if (is.data.frame(obj)) { found_name <- nm; data <- obj; break }
  }
}
if (is.null(found_name)) {
  # fallback: find any data.frame in environment
  all_objs <- ls(envir = .GlobalEnv)
  df_cands <- all_objs[sapply(all_objs, function(x) is.data.frame(get(x, envir = .GlobalEnv)))]
  if (length(df_cands) >= 1) {
    found_name <- df_cands[1]
    data <- get(found_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    message("Auto-detected dataset object (fallback): ", found_name)
  } else {
    stop("No data.frame found in environment. Create a data.frame named one of: ",
         paste(candidate_names, collapse = ", "), " or load your data and re-run.")
  }
} else {
  message("Using dataset object: ", found_name, " (", nrow(data), " rows x ", ncol(data), " cols )")
}

# ---------------- BASIC SAFETY PREPROCESSING ----------------
# size_of_downpayment "30%" -> 0.3 (if present)
if ("size_of_downpayment" %in% names(data)) {
  data$size_of_downpayment <- as.character(data$size_of_downpayment)
  data$size_of_downpayment <- gsub("%", "", data$size_of_downpayment)
  data$size_of_downpayment <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(data$size_of_downpayment) / 100)
}

# Normalize repaid_loan_on_prev_car -> 0/1 integer
if ("repaid_loan_on_prev_car" %in% names(data)) {
  col <- data$repaid_loan_on_prev_car
  if (is.logical(col)) {
    data$repaid_loan_on_prev_car <- as.integer(col)
  } else if (is.character(col)) {
    tmp <- tolower(trimws(col))
    data$repaid_loan_on_prev_car <- ifelse(tmp %in% c("1","true","t","yes","y"), 1,
                                    ifelse(tmp %in% c("0","false","f","no","n"), 0, NA))
  } else {
    data$repaid_loan_on_prev_car <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.numeric(col)))
  }
}

# Ensure salary_range as factor
if ("salary_range" %in% names(data) && !is.factor(data$salary_range)) {
  data$salary_range <- as.factor(data$salary_range)
}

# Ensure target exists and coerce to canonical factor levels
if (! (TARGET %in% names(data))) stop("Target column 'repaid' not found in dataset.")
if (is.numeric(data[[TARGET]]) || is.integer(data[[TARGET]])) {
  data[[TARGET]] <- factor(ifelse(data[[TARGET]] == 1, "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"),
                           levels = c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid"))
} else {
  tmp_lbl <- tolower(trimws(as.character(data[[TARGET]])))
  data[[TARGET]] <- factor(ifelse(tmp_lbl %in% c("1","true","yes","y","repaid","paid"), "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"),
                           levels = c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid"))
}

# ---------------- CHECK FEATURES AND BUILD MODELLING DF ----------------
missing_feats <- setdiff(FEATURES, names(data))
if (length(missing_feats) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required features: ", paste(missing_feats, collapse = ", "))
}
mod_df <- data[, c(FEATURES, TARGET)]
n_before <- nrow(mod_df)
mod_df <- mod_df[complete.cases(mod_df), ]
n_after <- nrow(mod_df)
message(sprintf("Rows: before=%d, after dropping NA in model cols=%d", n_before, n_after))
if (n_after < 30) stop("Too few rows left after dropping NA. Provide more data or relax NA dropping.")

# Ensure numeric conversion for numeric-needed fields
num_fields <- intersect(c("car_value","debt_to_income_ratio","loan_length","repaid_loan_on_prev_car"), names(mod_df))
for (f in num_fields) mod_df[[f]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(mod_df[[f]]))

# Keep copy for saving predictions with original values later
full_mod_df <- mod_df

# ---------------- TRAIN / TEST split (stratified) ----------------
set.seed(42)
train_idx <- createDataPartition(mod_df[[TARGET]], p = TRAIN_PROP, list = FALSE)
train <- mod_df[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
test  <- mod_df[-train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
message(sprintf("Created train (%d rows) / test (%d rows) [%.1f%% train]  CV folds = %d",
                nrow(train), nrow(test), 100 * nrow(train) / nrow(mod_df), CV_FOLDS))

# ---------------- ALIGN CATEGORICAL LEVELS ----------------
if ("salary_range" %in% names(train)) {
  train$salary_range <- as.character(train$salary_range); train$salary_range[is.na(train$salary_range)] <- "Missing"
  train_levels <- unique(train$salary_range); train_levels <- c(setdiff(train_levels, "Missing"), "Missing")
  train$salary_range <- factor(train$salary_range, levels = train_levels)
  if ("salary_range" %in% names(test)) {
    test$salary_range <- as.character(test$salary_range); test$salary_range[is.na(test$salary_range)] <- "Missing"
    unseen <- setdiff(unique(test$salary_range), train_levels)
    test$salary_range <- factor(test$salary_range, levels = c(train_levels, setdiff(unseen, "Missing")))
  }
}

# ---------------- DROP single-level predictors (train-only) ----------------
predictors <- setdiff(names(train), TARGET)
single_level <- sapply(predictors, function(p) length(unique(na.omit(as.character(train[[p]])))) <= 1)
if (any(single_level)) {
  drop_p <- names(single_level)[single_level]
  message("Dropping single-level predictors (train only): ", paste(drop_p, collapse = ", "))
  predictors <- setdiff(predictors, drop_p)
  train <- train[, c(predictors, TARGET), drop = FALSE]
  # align test columns as well
  keep_test <- intersect(names(test), c(predictors, TARGET))
  test <- test[, keep_test, drop = FALSE]
}

if (length(predictors) == 0) stop("No predictors left after pruning single-level variables.")

# ---------------- TRAIN CONTROL (10-fold CV) ----------------
ctrl <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = CV_FOLDS,
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
  savePredictions = "final",
  verboseIter = FALSE
)

# small tune grid
mtry_try <- unique(pmin(length(predictors), c(2, 3)))
tuneGrid <- expand.grid(mtry = mtry_try)

message(sprintf("Training RF (cv=%d): ntree=%d, mtry=%s", CV_FOLDS, NTREE, paste(mtry_try, collapse = ",")))

# ---------------- TRAIN Random Forest (caret) ----------------
set.seed(42)
rf_fit <- train(
  reformulate(predictors, response = TARGET),
  data = train,
  method = "rf",
  metric = "ROC",
  trControl = ctrl,
  tuneGrid = tuneGrid,
  ntree = NTREE,
  importance = TRUE
)

message("Training complete. BestTune:")
print(rf_fit$bestTune)
message("CV results (head):")
print(head(rf_fit$results))

saveRDS(rf_fit, file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_fit_phase1_cv10.rds"))
message("Saved RF model to: ", file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_fit_phase1_cv10.rds"))

# ---------------- VARIABLE IMPORTANCE ----------------
vi_obj <- tryCatch(varImp(rf_fit, scale = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(vi_obj)) {
  vi_df <- as.data.frame(vi_obj$importance, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  vi_df$Feature <- rownames(vi_df)
  # find numeric importance column
  num_cols <- names(vi_df)[sapply(vi_df, is.numeric)]
  imp_col <- if ("Overall" %in% num_cols) "Overall" else num_cols[1]
  vi_table <- vi_df %>% dplyr::select(!!imp_col, Feature) %>% dplyr::rename(Overall = !!imp_col) %>% dplyr::mutate(Overall = as.numeric(Overall)) %>% dplyr::arrange(desc(Overall))
  vi_table$Feature <- gsub("^`+|`+$", "", vi_table$Feature)
  vi_table$Feature <- gsub("\\\\", "", vi_table$Feature)
  write.csv(vi_table, file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_varimp_phase1_cv10.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  message("Saved variable importance CSV: ", file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_varimp_phase1_cv10.csv"))
  # print full importance table to console (top 30 or all)
  n_show <- min(30, nrow(vi_table))
  message("Top variable importance (showing ", n_show, " rows):")
  print(vi_table[1:n_show, , drop = FALSE])
} else {
  warning("varImp failed or returned NULL.")
}

# ---------------- PREDICTIONS ----------------
train_prob <- tryCatch(predict(rf_fit, newdata = train, type = "prob")[, "Repaid"], error = function(e) NULL)
train_pred <- tryCatch(predict(rf_fit, newdata = train, type = "raw"), error = function(e) NULL)
test_prob  <- tryCatch(predict(rf_fit, newdata = test,  type = "prob")[, "Repaid"], error = function(e) NULL)
test_pred  <- tryCatch(predict(rf_fit, newdata = test,  type = "raw"), error = function(e) NULL)

# ---------------- SAFE METRICS FUNCTION ----------------
compute_metrics_safe <- function(actual, pred_class = NULL, prob_vec = NULL) {
  # actual: character/factor of "Not_Repaid"/"Repaid"
  actual_f <- factor(as.character(actual), levels = c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid"))
  results <- list(Accuracy = NA_real_, Sensitivity = NA_real_, Specificity = NA_real_,
                  Precision = NA_real_, F1 = NA_real_, AUC = NA_real_,
                  TP = NA_integer_, TN = NA_integer_, FP = NA_integer_, FN = NA_integer_,
                  MCC = NA_real_, Gini = NA_real_, KS = NA_real_, confusion = NULL)
  # derive pred if missing and prob exists
  if (is.null(pred_class) && !is.null(prob_vec) && length(prob_vec) == length(actual_f)) {
    pred_class <- ifelse(as.numeric(prob_vec) >= 0.5, "Repaid", "Not_Repaid")
  }
  if (!is.null(pred_class)) {
    pred_f <- factor(as.character(pred_class), levels = c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid"))
    cm <- tryCatch(caret::confusionMatrix(pred_f, actual_f, positive = "Repaid"), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(cm)) {
      results$Accuracy <- as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"])
      results$Precision <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Precision"])
      results$Sensitivity <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"])
      results$Specificity <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Specificity"])
      results$F1 <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"])
      results$confusion <- cm$table
      tab <- as.matrix(cm$table)
      ref_levels <- colnames(tab); pred_levels <- rownames(tab)
      if (all(c("Not_Repaid","Repaid") %in% ref_levels) && all(c("Not_Repaid","Repaid") %in% pred_levels)) {
        TN <- as.numeric(tab["Not_Repaid","Not_Repaid"]); FN <- as.numeric(tab["Not_Repaid","Repaid"])
        FP <- as.numeric(tab["Repaid","Not_Repaid"]); TP <- as.numeric(tab["Repaid","Repaid"])
      } else {
        # fallback by positions
        TP <- as.numeric(tab[nrow(tab), ncol(tab)]); TN <- as.numeric(tab[1,1])
        FP <- as.numeric(tab[nrow(tab),1]); FN <- as.numeric(tab[1,ncol(tab)])
      }
      results$TP <- TP; results$TN <- TN; results$FP <- FP; results$FN <- FN
      den <- suppressWarnings(sqrt((TP+FP)*(TP+FN)*(TN+FP)*(TN+FN)))
      if (!is.na(den) && den != 0) results$MCC <- (TP*TN - FP*FN) / den else results$MCC <- NA_real_
    }
  }
  # AUC/Gini/KS
  if (!is.null(prob_vec) && length(prob_vec) == length(actual_f)) {
    roc_obj <- tryCatch(pROC::roc(response = as.numeric(actual_f == "Repaid"), predictor = as.numeric(prob_vec), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(roc_obj)) {
      auc_v <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj))
      results$AUC <- auc_v
      results$Gini <- 2 * auc_v - 1
      sensv <- roc_obj$sensitivities; specv <- roc_obj$specificities
      if (!is.null(sensv) && !is.null(specv) && length(sensv) == length(specv)) {
        results$KS <- max(abs(sensv - (1 - specv)))
      }
    }
  }
  return(results)
}

# ---------------- METRICS: TRAIN ----------------
train_metrics <- compute_metrics_safe(train[[TARGET]], pred_class = train_pred, prob_vec = train_prob)
cat("\n=== TRAIN set performance ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Rows (train): %d\n", nrow(train)))
cat(sprintf("Accuracy:  %.6f\n", train_metrics$Accuracy))
cat(sprintf("Sensitivity: %.6f\n", train_metrics$Sensitivity))
cat(sprintf("Specificity: %.6f\n", train_metrics$Specificity))
cat(sprintf("Precision: %.6f\n", train_metrics$Precision))
cat(sprintf("F1: %.6f\n", train_metrics$F1))
cat(sprintf("MCC: %.6f\n", train_metrics$MCC))
cat(sprintf("AUC: %.6f\n", train_metrics$AUC))
cat("\nConfusion matrix (train):\n"); print(train_metrics$confusion)

# Save train predictions (attach original predictors if available)
train_out <- train
train_out$pred_class <- if (!is.null(train_pred)) as.character(train_pred) else NA
train_out$prob_Repaid <- if (!is.null(train_prob)) as.numeric(train_prob) else NA_real_
write.csv(train_out, file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_train_preds_phase1_cv10.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
message("Saved train predictions to: ", file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_train_preds_phase1_cv10.csv"))

# ---------------- METRICS: TEST ----------------
if (TARGET %in% names(test) && !all(is.na(test[[TARGET]]) ) && !is.null(test_pred)) {
  test_metrics <- compute_metrics_safe(test[[TARGET]], pred_class = test_pred, prob_vec = test_prob)
  cat("\n=== TEST set performance ===\n")
  cat(sprintf("Rows (test): %d\n", nrow(test)))
  cat(sprintf("Accuracy:  %.6f\n", test_metrics$Accuracy))
  cat(sprintf("Sensitivity: %.6f\n", test_metrics$Sensitivity))
  cat(sprintf("Specificity: %.6f\n", test_metrics$Specificity))
  cat(sprintf("Precision: %.6f\n", test_metrics$Precision))
  cat(sprintf("F1: %.6f\n", test_metrics$F1))
  cat(sprintf("MCC: %.6f\n", test_metrics$MCC))
  cat(sprintf("AUC: %.6f\n", test_metrics$AUC))
  cat("\nConfusion matrix (test):\n"); print(test_metrics$confusion)

  test_out <- test
  test_out$pred_class <- if (!is.null(test_pred)) as.character(test_pred) else NA
  test_out$prob_Repaid <- if (!is.null(test_prob)) as.numeric(test_prob) else NA_real_
  write.csv(test_out, file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_test_preds_phase1_cv10.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  message("Saved test predictions to: ", file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_test_preds_phase1_cv10.csv"))
} else {
  message("Test labels or predictions not available; skipping test metrics/save.")
  test_metrics <- NULL
}

# ---------------- SAVE METRICS SUMMARY ----------------
metrics_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  Set = c("TRAIN", "TEST"),
  Rows = c(nrow(train), if (!is.null(test)) nrow(test) else NA_integer_),
  Accuracy = c(train_metrics$Accuracy, if (!is.null(test_metrics)) test_metrics$Accuracy else NA_real_),
  Sensitivity = c(train_metrics$Sensitivity, if (!is.null(test_metrics)) test_metrics$Sensitivity else NA_real_),
  Specificity = c(train_metrics$Specificity, if (!is.null(test_metrics)) test_metrics$Specificity else NA_real_),
  Precision = c(train_metrics$Precision, if (!is.null(test_metrics)) test_metrics$Precision else NA_real_),
  F1 = c(train_metrics$F1, if (!is.null(test_metrics)) test_metrics$F1 else NA_real_),
  MCC = c(train_metrics$MCC, if (!is.null(test_metrics)) test_metrics$MCC else NA_real_),
  AUC = c(train_metrics$AUC, if (!is.null(test_metrics)) test_metrics$AUC else NA_real_),
  Gini = c(train_metrics$Gini, if (!is.null(test_metrics)) test_metrics$Gini else NA_real_),
  KS = c(train_metrics$KS, if (!is.null(test_metrics)) test_metrics$KS else NA_real_)
)
write.csv(metrics_summary, file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_metrics_summary_phase1_cv10.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
message("Saved metrics summary: ", file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_metrics_summary_phase1_cv10.csv"))

# ---------------- ROC PLOTS ----------------
# Train ROC
if (!is.null(train_prob) && length(train_prob) == nrow(train)) {
  roc_train <- tryCatch(pROC::roc(response = as.numeric(train[[TARGET]] == "Repaid"), predictor = train_prob, quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(roc_train)) {
    png(file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_train_roc_phase1_cv10.png"), width = 800, height = 600)
    plot(roc_train, main = sprintf("RF Train ROC (AUC=%.4f)", as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_train))))
    dev.off()
    message("Saved train ROC: ", file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_train_roc_phase1_cv10.png"))
  }
}
# Test ROC
if (!is.null(test_prob) && length(test_prob) == nrow(test)) {
  roc_test <- tryCatch(pROC::roc(response = as.numeric(test[[TARGET]] == "Repaid"), predictor = test_prob, quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(roc_test)) {
    png(file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_test_roc_phase1_cv10.png"), width = 800, height = 600)
    plot(roc_test, main = sprintf("RF Test ROC (AUC=%.4f)", as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_test))))
    dev.off()
    message("Saved test ROC: ", file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_test_roc_phase1_cv10.png"))
  }
}

message("\nRandom Forest pipeline (Phase-1, CV=10) finished. All outputs in: ", normalizePath(OUT_DIR))

```

5.3 XGBoost
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# XGBoost End-to-End (Phase-1 Features Only, CV=10, Full Train/Test Metrics)
# ============================================================================

rm(list = ls())
set.seed(42)

# -------------------------
# Configuration
# -------------------------
data_path  <- "car_loan_data_with_tenure.csv"   
out_prefix <- "xgb_phase1"
OUT_DIR <- file.path(getwd(), paste0(out_prefix, "_outputs"))
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Use **exact 5 Phase-1 features**
FEATURES <- c(
  "car_value",
  "salary_range",
  "debt_to_income_ratio",
  "loan_length",
  "repaid_loan_on_prev_car"
)
TARGET <- "repaid"

TRAIN_PROP <- 0.70     # 70/30 split
CV_FOLDS   <- 10        # 10-fold CV


# -------------------------
# Packages
# -------------------------
req <- c("tidyverse","caret","xgboost","pROC","data.table","MLmetrics")
for(pk in req){
  if(!requireNamespace(pk, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(pk, dependencies = TRUE)
  library(pk, character.only = TRUE)
}

# -------------------------
# Load data
# -------------------------
if(exists("data") && is.data.frame(data)){
  message("Using in-memory data.")
} else {
  if(!file.exists(data_path)) stop("Data file does not exist: ", data_path)
  data <- read.csv(data_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
names(data) <- trimws(names(data))

# -------------------------
# Preprocess
# -------------------------

# Ensure required columns exist
miss <- setdiff(FEATURES, names(data))
if(length(miss) > 0) stop("Missing required feature(s): ", paste(miss, collapse=", "))

if(!(TARGET %in% names(data))) stop("Missing target column: repaid")

# salary_range factor
if(!is.factor(data$salary_range)) data$salary_range <- as.factor(data$salary_range)

# repaid_loan_on_prev_car → binary numeric
tmp <- tolower(trimws(as.character(data$repaid_loan_on_prev_car)))
data$repaid_loan_on_prev_car <- ifelse(tmp %in% c("true","t","yes","y","1"), 1,
                                ifelse(tmp %in% c("false","f","no","n","0"), 0, NA))

# numeric fields
for(cn in c("car_value","debt_to_income_ratio","loan_length","repaid_loan_on_prev_car")){
  data[[cn]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(data[[cn]]))
}

# Target normalization
tmp <- tolower(trimws(as.character(data$repaid)))
data$repaid <- factor(ifelse(tmp %in% 
                               c("1","true","yes","y","repaid","paid"), 
                             "Repaid","Not_Repaid"),
                      levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))

# Build df with only 5 features
df <- data[, c(FEATURES, TARGET)]
df <- df[complete.cases(df), ]

message("Rows after dropping NA: ", nrow(df))


# -------------------------
# Train/Test Split (70/30 stratified)
# -------------------------
set.seed(42)
idx <- createDataPartition(df$repaid, p = TRAIN_PROP, list = FALSE)
train_data <- df[idx, ]
test_data  <- df[-idx, ]

message("Train rows: ", nrow(train_data), "  Test rows: ", nrow(test_data))


# -------------------------
# caret XGBoost TrainControl (CV = 10)
# -------------------------
train_control_xgb <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = CV_FOLDS,
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
  savePredictions = "final",
  verboseIter = TRUE
)

# Basic grid (lightweight)
tune_grid_xgb <- expand.grid(
  nrounds = c(100, 200),
  max_depth = c(3, 5),
  eta = c(0.05, 0.1),
  gamma = 0,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  min_child_weight = 1,
  subsample = 0.8
)


# -------------------------
# Train XGBoost
# -------------------------
message("\nTraining XGBoost (CV=10, Phase-1 5 features)...")
t0 <- Sys.time()
xgb_model <- train(
  repaid ~ .,
  data = train_data,
  method = "xgbTree",
  trControl = train_control_xgb,
  tuneGrid = tune_grid_xgb,
  metric = "ROC",
  verbosity = 0
)
t1 <- Sys.time()

message("Training time (sec): ", round(as.numeric(difftime(t1,t0,units="secs")),1))
message("\nBest tuning parameters:"); print(xgb_model$bestTune)


# ============================================================================
# Helper for full metrics (safe)
# ============================================================================
compute_metrics <- function(actual, pred_class, prob){
  actual_f <- factor(actual, levels=c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
  pred_f   <- factor(pred_class, levels=c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))

  # confusion matrix
  cm <- confusionMatrix(pred_f, actual_f, positive="Repaid")

  # caret metrics
  acc  <- as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"])
  sens <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"])
  spec <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Specificity"])
  prec <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Precision"])
  f1   <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"])

  # explicit values
  tab <- as.matrix(cm$table)
  TN <- tab["Not_Repaid","Not_Repaid"]
  FN <- tab["Not_Repaid","Repaid"]
  FP <- tab["Repaid","Not_Repaid"]
  TP <- tab["Repaid","Repaid"]

  # MCC safe
  den <- sqrt((TP+FP)*(TP+FN)*(TN+FP)*(TN+FN))
  mcc <- ifelse(is.na(den) || den==0, NA, (TP*TN - FP*FN)/den)

  # AUC & KS
  roc_obj <- roc(response=actual_f, predictor=prob, levels=c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"), direction="<")
  auc_v <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
  gini  <- 2*auc_v - 1
  ks_v  <- max(abs(roc_obj$sensitivities - (1-roc_obj$specificities)))

  list(Accuracy=acc, Sensitivity=sens, Specificity=spec,
       Precision=prec, F1=f1, AUC=auc_v, Gini=gini, KS=ks_v,
       MCC=mcc, TP=TP,TN=TN,FP=FP,FN=FN, CM=cm$table)
}


# ============================================================================
# TRAIN Predictions
# ============================================================================
train_prob <- predict(xgb_model, train_data, type="prob")[,"Repaid"]
train_pred <- predict(xgb_model, train_data, type="raw")
train_metrics <- compute_metrics(train_data$repaid, train_pred, train_prob)

cat("\n=== TRAIN METRICS ===\n")
print(train_metrics)
cat("\nTRAIN Confusion Matrix:\n")
print(train_metrics$CM)

# save preds
train_out <- data.frame(train_data, pred_class=train_pred, prob_Repaid=train_prob)
write.csv(train_out, file.path(OUT_DIR,"train_predictions.csv"), row.names=FALSE)


# ============================================================================
# TEST Predictions
# ============================================================================
test_prob <- predict(xgb_model, test_data, type="prob")[,"Repaid"]
test_pred <- predict(xgb_model, test_data, type="raw")
test_metrics <- compute_metrics(test_data$repaid, test_pred, test_prob)

cat("\n=== TEST METRICS ===\n")
print(test_metrics)
cat("\nTEST Confusion Matrix:\n")
print(test_metrics$CM)

# save preds
test_out <- data.frame(test_data, pred_class=test_pred, prob_Repaid=test_prob)
write.csv(test_out, file.path(OUT_DIR,"test_predictions.csv"), row.names=FALSE)


# ============================================================================
# Variable Importance
# ============================================================================
vi <- varImp(xgb_model, scale=TRUE)
vi_df <- as.data.frame(vi$importance)
vi_df$Feature <- rownames(vi_df)
vi_df <- vi_df[order(-vi_df$Overall), ]
write.csv(vi_df, file.path(OUT_DIR,"variable_importance.csv"), row.names=FALSE)

cat("\n=== Variable Importance (Top) ===\n")
print(head(vi_df, 20))


# ============================================================================
# ROC Plots
# ============================================================================
if (!is.null(train_prob)) {
  roc_train <- roc(train_data$repaid, train_prob, levels=c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"), direction="<")
  png(file.path(OUT_DIR,"ROC_train.png"),800,600)
  plot(roc_train, main=sprintf("Train ROC (AUC=%.4f)", auc(roc_train)))
  dev.off()
}

if (!is.null(test_prob)) {
  roc_test <- roc(test_data$repaid, test_prob, levels=c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"), direction="<")
  png(file.path(OUT_DIR,"ROC_test.png"),800,600)
  plot(roc_test, main=sprintf("Test ROC (AUC=%.4f)", auc(roc_test)))
  dev.off()
}

cat("\nAll XGBoost (Phase-1, 5 features, CV=10) outputs saved under:\n",
    normalizePath(OUT_DIR), "\n")


```

6. Model Evaluation
6.1 Performance Metrics
```{r}
# full_pipeline_all3_cv10_grid_rf.R
# End-to-end: LR (glm), RF (grid mtry), XGBoost (xgbTree)
# Fixed: 5 features, stratified 70/30 split, 10-fold CV
# Save models, preds, varimp, ROC plots, metrics and comparison tables.

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  libs <- c("caret","randomForest","xgboost","pROC","dplyr","tibble","ggplot2","data.table","Matrix")
  for (pk in libs) if (!requireNamespace(pk, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(pk, dependencies = TRUE)
  lapply(libs, library, character.only = TRUE)
})

set.seed(42)

# ---------------- CONFIG ----------------
OUT_DIR <- file.path(getwd(), "model_outputs")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

data_path <- "car_loan_data_with_tenure.csv"  # if you don't have 'data' in env, this will be used
FEATURES <- c("car_value", "salary_range", "debt_to_income_ratio", "loan_length", "repaid_loan_on_prev_car")
TARGET <- "repaid"
TRAIN_PROP <- 0.7
CV_FOLDS <- 10
RF_NTREE <- 200   # set heavier ensemble; reduce to 100 for very light machines
RF_MTRY_MAX <- 6  # grid upper bound (will be min(p, RF_MTRY_MAX))
XGB_TUNE_SMALL <- TRUE  # set small XGB grid (fast)

# ---------------- LOAD / FIND DATA ----------------
if (exists("data") && is.data.frame(data)) {
  message("Using data already in environment (object 'data').")
} else {
  if (!file.exists(data_path)) stop("No 'data' object in environment and data_path not found: ", data_path)
  data <- read.csv(data_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  message("Loaded data from: ", data_path)
}
# trim column names
names(data) <- trimws(names(data))

# ---------------- PREPROCESS (safe) ----------------
# normalize size_of_downpayment
if ("size_of_downpayment" %in% names(data)) {
  data$size_of_downpayment <- as.character(data$size_of_downpayment)
  data$size_of_downpayment <- gsub("%", "", data$size_of_downpayment)
  data$size_of_downpayment <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(data$size_of_downpayment) / 100)
}

# repaid_loan_on_prev_car -> 0/1
if ("repaid_loan_on_prev_car" %in% names(data)) {
  col <- data$repaid_loan_on_prev_car
  if (is.logical(col)) data$repaid_loan_on_prev_car <- as.integer(col)
  else if (is.character(col)) {
    tmp <- tolower(trimws(col))
    data$repaid_loan_on_prev_car <- ifelse(tmp %in% c("1","true","t","yes","y"), 1,
                                           ifelse(tmp %in% c("0","false","f","no","n"), 0, NA))
  } else {
    data$repaid_loan_on_prev_car <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.numeric(col)))
  }
}

# ensure salary_range is factor
if ("salary_range" %in% names(data) && !is.factor(data$salary_range)) data$salary_range <- as.factor(data$salary_range)

# target normalization to two classes
if (! (TARGET %in% names(data))) stop("Target column 'repaid' not found in dataset.")
if (is.numeric(data[[TARGET]]) || is.integer(data[[TARGET]])) {
  data[[TARGET]] <- factor(ifelse(data[[TARGET]] == 1, "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"),
                           levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
} else {
  tmp <- tolower(trimws(as.character(data[[TARGET]])))
  data[[TARGET]] <- factor(ifelse(tmp %in% c("1","true","yes","y","repaid","paid"), "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"),
                           levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
}

# ---------------- CHECK FEATURES & BUILD DF ----------------
missing_feats <- setdiff(FEATURES, names(data))
if (length(missing_feats) > 0) stop("Missing required features: ", paste(missing_feats, collapse = ", "))
model_df <- data[, c(FEATURES, TARGET)]

n_before <- nrow(model_df)
model_df <- model_df[complete.cases(model_df), ]
n_after <- nrow(model_df)
message(sprintf("Rows: before=%d, after dropping NA in modeling cols=%d", n_before, n_after))
if (n_after < 30) stop("Too few rows after dropping NA. Need more data.")

# ensure numeric for numeric columns
num_names <- intersect(c("car_value","debt_to_income_ratio","loan_length","repaid_loan_on_prev_car"), names(model_df))
for (nm in num_names) model_df[[nm]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(model_df[[nm]]))

# ensure salary_range factor
if ("salary_range" %in% names(model_df) && !is.factor(model_df$salary_range)) model_df$salary_range <- as.factor(model_df$salary_range)

# ---------------- SPLIT (stratified) ----------------
set.seed(42)
train_idx <- createDataPartition(model_df[[TARGET]], p = TRAIN_PROP, list = FALSE)
train_data <- model_df[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
test_data  <- model_df[-train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
message(sprintf("Train rows: %d ; Test rows: %d", nrow(train_data), nrow(test_data)))

# align factor levels train -> test
for (col in names(train_data)) {
  if (is.factor(train_data[[col]])) {
    train_levels <- levels(train_data[[col]])
    test_data[[col]] <- factor(as.character(test_data[[col]]), levels = c(train_levels, setdiff(unique(as.character(test_data[[col]])), train_levels)))
  }
}

# remove single-level predictors in train
predictors <- setdiff(names(train_data), TARGET)
single_level <- sapply(predictors, function(p) length(unique(na.omit(as.character(train_data[[p]])))) <= 1)
if (any(single_level)) {
  drop_p <- names(single_level)[single_level]
  message("Dropping single-level predictors: ", paste(drop_p, collapse = ", "))
  predictors <- setdiff(predictors, drop_p)
  train_data <- train_data[, c(predictors, TARGET), drop = FALSE]
  test_data  <- test_data[, intersect(c(predictors, TARGET), names(test_data)), drop = FALSE]
}

if (length(predictors) == 0) stop("No predictors left after pruning.")

# ---------------- TRAIN CONTROL 10-fold CV ----------------
train_control <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = CV_FOLDS,
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
  savePredictions = "final",
  verboseIter = FALSE
)

# ---------------- LOGISTIC REGRESSION (caret glm) ----------------
message("\n>>> Training Logistic Regression (glm) with 10-fold CV")
set.seed(42)
# build dummyVars to avoid factor contrasts issues
dv <- dummyVars(reformulate(predictors), data = train_data, fullRank = TRUE)
train_lr_x <- predict(dv, newdata = train_data)
train_lr_df <- as.data.frame(train_lr_x, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
train_lr_df[[TARGET]] <- train_data[[TARGET]]
test_lr_df <- as.data.frame(predict(dv, newdata = test_data), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if (TARGET %in% names(test_data)) test_lr_df[[TARGET]] <- test_data[[TARGET]]

lr_fit <- train(
  formula(paste(TARGET, "~ .")),
  data = train_lr_df,
  method = "glm",
  family = "binomial",
  trControl = train_control,
  metric = "ROC",
  preProcess = c("center","scale")
)
saveRDS(lr_fit, file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_fit_caret.rds"))
message("Saved lr_fit to: ", file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_fit_caret.rds"))

# varImp for lr
var_imp_lr <- tryCatch(varImp(lr_fit, scale = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(var_imp_lr)) {
  vi_lr_df <- as.data.frame(var_imp_lr$importance); vi_lr_df$Feature <- rownames(vi_lr_df)
  vi_lr_df <- vi_lr_df %>% arrange(desc(ifelse("Overall" %in% names(vi_lr_df), Overall, vi_lr_df[[1]])))
  write.csv(vi_lr_df, file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_varimp.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}

# preds for LR
lr_pred_prob <- tryCatch(predict(lr_fit, newdata = test_lr_df, type = "prob"), error = function(e) NULL)
lr_pred_class <- tryCatch(predict(lr_fit, newdata = test_lr_df, type = "raw"), error = function(e) NULL)
# save preds
lr_out <- test_data
if (!is.null(lr_pred_class)) lr_out$pred_class <- as.character(lr_pred_class) else lr_out$pred_class <- NA
if (!is.null(lr_pred_prob) && "Repaid" %in% colnames(lr_pred_prob)) lr_out$prob_Repaid <- as.numeric(lr_pred_prob[,"Repaid"]) else lr_out$prob_Repaid <- NA
write.csv(lr_out, file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_test_preds.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# ---------------- RANDOM FOREST (caret, grid search mtry 1..min(p,RF_MTRY_MAX)) ----------------
message("\n>>> Training Random Forest (caret) with 10-fold CV and grid search mtry")

p <- length(predictors)
mtry_vals <- unique(pmin(p, seq(1, min(p, RF_MTRY_MAX))))
tuneGrid_rf <- expand.grid(mtry = mtry_vals)

message("RF grid mtry: ", paste(mtry_vals, collapse = ", "))

  reformulate(predictors, response = TARGET),

# varImp for RF

if (!is.null(var_imp_rf)) {
  vi_rf_df <- as.data.frame(var_imp_rf$importance); vi_rf_df$Feature <- rownames(vi_rf_df)
  # detect column

# preds for RF

}

# prepare train_data for xgboost: caret handles factors, but ensure no ordered factors

test_xgb  <- test_data

# convert ordered to numeric if any
for (col in names(train_xgb)) {
  if (col == TARGET) next
  if (is.ordered(train_xgb[[col]])) train_xgb[[col]] <- as.numeric(train_xgb[[col]])
  if (is.ordered(test_xgb[[col]])) test_xgb[[col]] <- as.numeric(test_xgb[[col]])
}

set.seed(42)
xgb_fit <- train(
  reformulate(predictors, response = TARGET),

# varImp for XGB

  vi_xgb_df <- vi_xgb_df[order(-vi_xgb_df$Overall), ]
  write.csv(vi_xgb_df, file.path(OUT_DIR, "xgb_varimp.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}

# preds for XGB
xgb_pred_prob <- tryCatch(predict(xgb_fit, newdata = test_xgb, type = "prob"), error = function(e) NULL)
xgb_pred_class <- tryCatch(predict(xgb_fit, newdata = test_xgb, type = "raw"), error = function(e) NULL)
xgb_out <- test_xgb
xgb_out$pred_class <- if (!is.null(xgb_pred_class)) as.character(xgb_pred_class) else NA
xgb_out$prob_Repaid <- if (!is.null(xgb_pred_prob) && "Repaid" %in% colnames(xgb_pred_prob)) as.numeric(xgb_pred_prob[,"Repaid"]) else NA
write.csv(xgb_out, file.path(OUT_DIR, "xgb_test_preds.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# ---------------- Evaluation helper (robust) ----------------
extract_positive_prob <- function(obj) {
  if (is.null(obj)) return(NULL)
  if (is.numeric(obj) && is.vector(obj)) return(as.numeric(obj))
  if (is.data.frame(obj) || is.matrix(obj)) {
    cn <- colnames(obj)
    if (!is.null(cn) && "Repaid" %in% cn) return(as.numeric(obj[,"Repaid"]))
    if (ncol(obj) == 2) return(as.numeric(obj[,2]))
    # first numeric column
    numcols <- sapply(as.data.frame(obj), is.numeric)
    if (any(numcols)) return(as.numeric(obj[[which(numcols)[1]]]))
  }
  NULL
}

compute_metrics_safe <- function(actual, pred = NULL, prob = NULL) {
  actual_f <- factor(as.character(actual), levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
  if (!is.null(pred)) pred_f <- factor(as.character(pred), levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid")) else pred_f <- NULL
  result <- list(Accuracy=NA, Sensitivity=NA, Specificity=NA, Precision=NA, F1=NA, AUC=NA, Kappa=NA, confusion = NULL)
  if (!is.null(pred_f) && length(pred_f) == length(actual_f)) {
    cm <- tryCatch(confusionMatrix(pred_f, actual_f, positive = "Repaid"), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(cm)) {
      result$Accuracy <- as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"])
      result$Sensitivity <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"])
      result$Specificity <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Specificity"])
      result$Precision <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Precision"])
      result$F1 <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"])
      result$Kappa <- as.numeric(cm$overall["Kappa"])
      result$confusion <- cm$table
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(prob) && length(prob) == length(actual_f)) {
    roc_o <- tryCatch(pROC::roc(response = as.numeric(actual_f == "Repaid"), predictor = as.numeric(prob), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(roc_o)) result$AUC <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_o))
  }
  result
}

# ---------------- Collect metrics & ROC objects ----------------
models <- list(
  LR = list(fit = lr_fit, pred_df = lr_out, prob = extract_positive_prob(lr_pred_prob), class = lr_pred_class, varimp = var_imp_lr),
  RF = list(fit = rf_fit, pred_df = rf_out, prob = extract_positive_prob(rf_pred_prob), class = rf_pred_class, varimp = var_imp_rf),
  XGB = list(fit = xgb_fit, pred_df = xgb_out, prob = extract_positive_prob(xgb_pred_prob), class = xgb_pred_class, varimp = var_imp_xgb)
)

metrics_list <- list()
roc_list <- list()
for (mname in names(models)) {
  m <- models[[mname]]
  # choose actual vector (from test_data)
  actual_v <- if ("repaid" %in% colnames(test_data)) test_data$repaid else m$pred_df[[TARGET]]
  prob_v <- m$prob
  pred_v <- m$class
  # if missing prob/class but model object exists, predict
  if (is.null(prob_v) && !is.null(m$fit)) {
    prb_try <- tryCatch(predict(m$fit, newdata = test_data, type = "prob"), error = function(e) NULL)
    prob_v <- extract_positive_prob(prb_try)
  }
  if (is.null(pred_v) && !is.null(m$fit)) {
    pr_try <- tryCatch(predict(m$fit, newdata = test_data, type = "raw"), error = function(e) NULL)
    pred_v <- pr_try
  }
  metrics <- compute_metrics_safe(actual_v, pred_v, prob_v)
  metrics_list[[mname]] <- metrics
  # store roc object for plotting if prob exists
  if (!is.null(prob_v) && length(prob_v) == length(actual_v)) {
    roc_o <- tryCatch(pROC::roc(response = as.numeric(factor(as.character(actual_v), levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid")) == "Repaid"), predictor = as.numeric(prob_v), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(roc_o)) roc_list[[mname]] <- roc_o
  }
}

# build comparison table
comp_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(metrics_list), function(nm) {
  mt <- metrics_list[[nm]]
  tibble::tibble(Model = nm,
                 Accuracy = mt$Accuracy,
                 Sensitivity = mt$Sensitivity,
                 Specificity = mt$Specificity,
                 Precision = mt$Precision,
                 F1_Score = mt$F1,
                 AUC = mt$AUC,
                 Kappa = mt$Kappa)
}))
comp_df <- as.data.frame(comp_df)
print(comp_df)
write.csv(comp_df, file.path(OUT_DIR, "models_comparison_metrics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
message("Saved comparison metrics to:", file.path(OUT_DIR, "models_comparison_metrics.csv"))

# ---------------- Combined ROC plot ----------------
if (length(roc_list) > 0) {
  roc_df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(roc_list), function(nm) {
    r <- roc_list[[nm]]
    data.frame(model = nm, fpr = 1 - r$specificities, tpr = r$sensitivities, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }), .id = NULL)
  p <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(x = fpr, y = tpr, color = model)) +
    geom_line(size = 1) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    labs(x = "False Positive Rate", y = "True Positive Rate", title = "ROC Curves - Model Comparison") +
    theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "models_combined_roc.png"), plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 150)
  message("Saved combined ROC to:", file.path(OUT_DIR, "models_combined_roc.png"))
} else {
  message("No ROC curves (no probability vectors found).")
}

# ---------------- Save artifacts ----------------
saveRDS(models, file.path(OUT_DIR, "all_models_list.rds"))
write.csv(as.data.frame(test_data), file.path(OUT_DIR, "test_data_saved.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
message("Saved test_data and models to:", OUT_DIR)

message("\nPipeline finished. Files under:", normalizePath(OUT_DIR))
```

6.3 ROC Curves Comparison
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# ROC Curves Comparison (robust collector + plot + save)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n=== ROC Curves Comparison (robust) ===\n")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(pROC)
  library(readr)   # for read_csv-like convenience (read.csv fallback used if missing)
})

# Helper: extract positive-class probability from typical structures
extract_positive_prob <- function(obj) {
  if (is.null(obj)) return(NULL)
  # numeric vector
  if (is.numeric(obj) && is.vector(obj)) return(as.numeric(obj))
  # data.frame or matrix with columns
  if (is.data.frame(obj) || is.matrix(obj)) {
    cn <- colnames(obj)
    if (!is.null(cn) && "Repaid" %in% cn) return(as.numeric(obj[,"Repaid"]))
    # if two columns, assume second is positive
    if (ncol(obj) == 2) return(as.numeric(obj[,2]))
    # otherwise choose first numeric column
    numcols <- sapply(as.data.frame(obj), is.numeric)
    if (any(numcols)) return(as.numeric(obj[, which(numcols)[1]]))
  }
  NULL
}

# Helper: read predictions CSVs in model_outputs or current working dir
read_preds_csv_try <- function(prefix) {
  candidates <- c(
    file.path("model_outputs", paste0(prefix, "_test_preds.csv")),
    file.path("model_outputs", paste0(prefix, "_test_predictions.csv")),
    file.path("model_outputs", paste0(prefix, "_test_predictions_all.csv")),
    paste0(prefix, "_test_preds.csv"),
    paste0(prefix, "_test_predictions.csv")
  )
  for (f in unique(candidates)) {
    if (file.exists(f)) {
      df <- tryCatch(read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(df)) return(list(df = df, path = f))
    }
  }
  NULL
}

# Helper: find actual labels (priority: CSV actual column -> test_data$repaid -> global test/test_data variants)
find_actual_labels <- function(csv_df = NULL) {
  # CSV actual column
  if (!is.null(csv_df)) {
    cn_low <- tolower(colnames(csv_df))
    idx <- which(grepl("^actual$|^y$|^label$|^truth$|^target$|^repaid$", cn_low))
    if (length(idx) > 0) return(as.character(csv_df[[ idx[1] ]]))
    if ("actual" %in% colnames(csv_df)) return(as.character(csv_df$actual))
    if ("repaid" %in% colnames(csv_df)) return(as.character(csv_df$repaid))
  }
  # environment objects
  for (nm in c("test_data", "test", "test_df", "test_data_final")) {
    if (exists(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
      td <- get(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      if (is.data.frame(td) && "repaid" %in% names(td)) return(as.character(td$repaid))
    }
  }
  NULL
}

# Helper: try to produce a roc object for a model prefix
# prefix: "lr", "rf", "xgb"
collect_roc_for_prefix <- function(prefix, color = "#000000", label = NULL) {
  label <- if (is.null(label)) toupper(prefix) else label
  # 1) check for existing eval object like "<prefix>_eval" with $roc
  eval_name <- paste0(prefix, "_eval")
  if (exists(eval_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    ev <- get(eval_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    if (!is.null(ev$roc) && inherits(ev$roc, "roc")) {
      auc_v <- tryCatch(auc(ev$roc), error = function(e) NA_real_)
      return(list(roc = ev$roc, auc = auc_v, label = sprintf("%s (AUC=%.4f)", label, auc_v), col = color))
    }
  }

  # 2) try pred probs in env: "<prefix>_pred_prob", "<prefix>_pred_probs", "<prefix>_prob"
  for (nm in c(paste0(prefix, "_pred_prob"), paste0(prefix, "_pred_probs"), paste0(prefix, "_prob"),
               paste0(prefix, "_pred_prob_vec"))) {
    if (exists(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
      prob_obj <- get(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      prob_v <- extract_positive_prob(prob_obj)
      actual_v <- find_actual_labels()
      if (!is.null(prob_v) && !is.null(actual_v) && length(prob_v) == length(actual_v)) {
        roc_o <- tryCatch(pROC::roc(response = as.numeric(tolower(as.character(actual_v)) %in% c("1","repaid","yes","true","y")),
                                   predictor = as.numeric(prob_v), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (!is.null(roc_o)) {
          auc_v <- tryCatch(auc(roc_o), error = function(e) NA_real_)
          return(list(roc = roc_o, auc = auc_v, label = sprintf("%s (AUC=%.4f)", label, auc_v), col = color))
        }
      }
    }
  }

  # 3) try model object in env (caret train objects or xgboost)
  model_candidates <- c(paste0(prefix, "_fit"), paste0(prefix, "_model"), paste0(prefix, "model"), prefix)
  for (mn in model_candidates) {
    if (exists(mn, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
      m <- get(mn, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      # caret::train
      if (inherits(m, "train")) {
        if (exists("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
          td <- get("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)
        } else if (exists("test", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
          td <- get("test", envir = .GlobalEnv)
        } else td <- NULL
        if (!is.null(td) && is.data.frame(td)) {
          prob_try <- tryCatch(predict(m, newdata = td, type = "prob"), error = function(e) NULL)
          pred_try <- tryCatch(predict(m, newdata = td, type = "raw"), error = function(e) NULL)
          prob_v <- extract_positive_prob(prob_try)
          actual_v <- if (!is.null(td$repaid)) as.character(td$repaid) else find_actual_labels()
          if (!is.null(prob_v) && !is.null(actual_v) && length(prob_v) == length(actual_v)) {
            roc_o <- tryCatch(pROC::roc(response = as.numeric(tolower(as.character(actual_v)) %in% c("1","repaid","yes","true","y")),
                                       predictor = as.numeric(prob_v), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
            if (!is.null(roc_o)) {
              auc_v <- tryCatch(auc(roc_o), error = function(e) NA_real_)
              return(list(roc = roc_o, auc = auc_v, label = sprintf("%s (AUC=%.4f)", label, auc_v), col = color))
            }
          }
        }
      }
      # xgboost native booster (try to predict if possible)
      if (inherits(m, "xgb.Booster") || inherits(m, "xgb.Booster.handle")) {
        if (exists("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
          td <- get("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)
          tdf <- if ("repaid" %in% colnames(td)) td[ , setdiff(colnames(td), "repaid"), drop = FALSE] else td
          X_test <- tryCatch(sparse.model.matrix(~ . -1, data = tdf), error = function(e) NULL)
          if (!is.null(X_test)) {
            prob_try <- tryCatch(predict(m, xgb.DMatrix(X_test)), error = function(e) NULL)
            actual_v <- if ("repaid" %in% colnames(td)) as.character(td$repaid) else find_actual_labels()
            if (!is.null(prob_try) && !is.null(actual_v) && length(prob_try) == length(actual_v)) {
              roc_o <- tryCatch(pROC::roc(response = as.numeric(tolower(as.character(actual_v)) %in% c("1","repaid","yes","true","y")),
                                         predictor = as.numeric(prob_try), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
              if (!is.null(roc_o)) {
                auc_v <- tryCatch(auc(roc_o), error = function(e) NA_real_)
                return(list(roc = roc_o, auc = auc_v, label = sprintf("%s (AUC=%.4f)", label, auc_v), col = color))
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  # 4) try CSV predictions in model_outputs or working dir
  csv_try <- read_preds_csv_try(prefix)
  if (!is.null(csv_try)) {
    df <- csv_try$df
    # find prob column
    prob_col_candidates <- grep("prob|probability|pred_prob|repaid_prob", tolower(colnames(df)), value = TRUE)
    prob_v <- NULL
    if (length(prob_col_candidates) > 0) prob_v <- extract_positive_prob(df[[prob_col_candidates[1]]])
    if (is.null(prob_v)) {
      # fallback numeric columns
      nums <- colnames(df)[sapply(df, is.numeric)]
      if (length(nums) >= 1) {
        # prefer second numeric column (often first is id)
        idx <- min(2, length(nums))
        prob_v <- extract_positive_prob(df[[ nums[idx] ]])
      }
    }
    actual_v <- find_actual_labels(df)
    if (!is.null(prob_v) && !is.null(actual_v) && length(prob_v) == length(actual_v)) {
      roc_o <- tryCatch(pROC::roc(response = as.numeric(tolower(as.character(actual_v)) %in% c("1","repaid","yes","true","y")),
                                 predictor = as.numeric(prob_v), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(roc_o)) {
        auc_v <- tryCatch(auc(roc_o), error = function(e) NA_real_)
        return(list(roc = roc_o, auc = auc_v, label = sprintf("%s (AUC=%.4f)", label, auc_v), col = color, source = csv_try$path))
      }
    }
  }

  # nothing found
  return(NULL)
}

# Collect ROCs for LR / RF / XGB (customize colors/labels if you want)
roc_collect <- list(
  lr  = collect_roc_for_prefix("lr",  "#e74c3c", "Logistic Regression"),
  rf  = collect_roc_for_prefix("rf",  "#3498db", "Random Forest"),
  xgb = collect_roc_for_prefix("xgb", "#2ecc71", "XGBoost")
)

# Filter present entries
roc_collect <- Filter(Negate(is.null), roc_collect)

if (length(roc_collect) == 0) {
  cat("No ROC objects/probabilities found for lr/rf/xgb — skipping ROC plot.\n")
} else {
  # prepare plot file
  out_dir <- if (dir.exists("model_outputs")) "model_outputs" else "."
  out_png <- file.path(out_dir, "models_combined_roc.png")

  # plot first
  first <- roc_collect[[1]]
  png(out_png, width = 900, height = 700)
  plot(first$roc, col = first$col, lwd = 2, main = "ROC Curves Comparison", legacy.axes = TRUE)
  # add others
  if (length(roc_collect) > 1) {
    i <- 2
    for (nm in names(roc_collect)[-1]) {
      r <- roc_collect[[nm]]
      plot(r$roc, add = TRUE, col = r$col, lwd = 2)
      i <- i + 1
    }
  }
  abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "gray50")
  # legend labels
  legend_labels <- sapply(roc_collect, function(x) x$label)
  legend_cols <- sapply(roc_collect, function(x) x$col)
  legend("bottomright", legend = legend_labels, col = legend_cols, lwd = 2, cex = 0.9)
  dev.off()

  cat("Saved combined ROC plot to:", out_png, "\n")

  # print AUC table to console
  auc_df <- data.frame(
    Model = names(roc_collect),
    AUC = sapply(roc_collect, function(x) as.numeric(x$auc)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  # nicer model names
  auc_df$Model <- toupper(auc_df$Model)
  print(auc_df)

  invisible(list(roc_list = roc_collect, auc_df = auc_df, png = out_png))
}

cat("✓ ROC collection finished.\n")
```
