6.4 Variable Importance Comparison
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# Variable Importance Comparison (robust + save)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n=== Variable Importance Comparison (robust) ===\n")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(gridExtra)
  library(dplyr)
})

OUT_DIR <- if (dir.exists("model_outputs")) "model_outputs" else "."
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Helper: convert a varImp-like object or dataframe to a canonical df with columns:
#   Feature, Importance (numeric)
normalize_varimp_df <- function(x, prefer_overall = TRUE) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
  # caret varImp.train object: x$importance
  if (inherits(x, "varImp.train") && !is.null(x$importance)) {
    df <- as.data.frame(x$importance, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else if (is.data.frame(x)) {
    df <- x
  } else if (is.list(x) && !is.null(x$importance) && is.data.frame(x$importance)) {
    df <- as.data.frame(x$importance, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
  # Add Feature column from rownames if missing
  if (!"Feature" %in% names(df)) {
    df$Feature <- rownames(df)
  }
  # choose numeric importance column
  numcols <- names(df)[sapply(df, is.numeric)]
  imp_col <- NULL
  if (prefer_overall && "Overall" %in% names(df) && is.numeric(df$Overall)) imp_col <- "Overall"
  else if (length(numcols) >= 1) imp_col <- numcols[1]
  if (is.null(imp_col)) return(NULL)
  out <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(imp_col), Feature) %>%
    dplyr::rename(Importance = !!imp_col) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Importance = as.numeric(Importance)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(Importance))
  # clean Feature names
  out$Feature <- gsub("^`+|`+$", "", out$Feature)
  out$Feature <- gsub("\\\\", "", out$Feature)
  out$Feature <- trimws(as.character(out$Feature))
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  return(out)
}

# Try multiple sources to get varImp for a prefix (lr, rf, xgb)
get_varimp_for_prefix <- function(prefix) {
  # 1) direct env object names: var_imp_<prefix>
  env_names <- c(paste0("var_imp_", prefix))
  for (nm in env_names) if (exists(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    v <- get(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    df <- normalize_varimp_df(v)
    if (!is.null(df)) return(list(df = df, source = nm))
  }

  # 2) try varImp(model) if model exists (caret::train)
  model_candidates <- c(paste0(prefix, "_fit"), paste0(prefix, "_model"), paste0(prefix, "model"), prefix)
  for (mn in model_candidates) {
    if (exists(mn, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
      m <- get(mn, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      vi_try <- tryCatch(varImp(m, scale = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(vi_try)) {
        df <- normalize_varimp_df(vi_try)
        if (!is.null(df)) return(list(df = df, source = sprintf("varImp(%s)", mn)))
      }
    }
  }

  # 3) try reading varimp CSV in model_outputs or current dir matching prefix
  csv_candidates <- c(
    file.path("model_outputs", paste0(prefix, "_varimp.csv")),
    file.path("model_outputs", paste0(prefix, "_varimp_*.csv")),
    file.path("model_outputs", paste0("*", prefix, "*varimp*.csv")),
    paste0(prefix, "_varimp.csv")
  )
  # glob-like: list files and try to find matching names
  files <- unique(c(
    list.files("model_outputs", pattern = paste0(prefix, ".*varimp.*", collapse = "|"), full.names = TRUE),
    list.files(".", pattern = paste0(prefix, ".*varimp.*", collapse = "|"), full.names = TRUE)
  ))
  if (length(files) > 0) {
    for (f in files) {
      df_raw <- tryCatch(read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(df_raw)) {
        df <- normalize_varimp_df(df_raw)
        if (!is.null(df)) return(list(df = df, source = f))
      }
    }
  }

  # nothing found
  return(NULL)
}

# Get varImp for known prefixes
prefixes <- c("logit" = "Logistic Regression", "lr" = "Logistic Regression",
              "rf" = "Random Forest", "xgb" = "XGBoost")
col_map <- c("Logistic Regression" = "#e74c3c", "Random Forest" = "#3498db", "XGBoost" = "#2ecc71")

collected <- list()
seen_models <- character(0)
for (p in names(prefixes)) {
  res <- get_varimp_for_prefix(p)
  if (!is.null(res)) {
    pretty_name <- prefixes[p]
    # avoid duplicates (lr and logit both map to LR)
    if (!(pretty_name %in% seen_models)) {
      collected[[pretty_name]] <- list(df = res$df, source = res$source, color = col_map[[pretty_name]])
      seen_models <- c(seen_models, pretty_name)
    }
  }
}

if (length(collected) == 0) {
  cat("No variable importance objects found for LR/RF/XGB — skipping variable importance plot.\n")
} else {
  # prepare list of ggplots
  plot_list <- list()
  printed_tables <- list()
  for (nm in names(collected)) {
    vi_df <- collected[[nm]]$df
    src   <- collected[[nm]]$source
    color <- collected[[nm]]$color
    # keep top 15 for plot
    topn <- head(vi_df, 15)
    p <- ggplot(topn, aes(x = reorder(Feature, Importance), y = Importance)) +
      geom_col(fill = color) +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(title = nm, subtitle = paste0("source: ", src), x = NULL, y = "Importance") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
    plot_list[[nm]] <- p
    # print top table to console
    cat(sprintf("\nTop %d features for %s (source: %s):\n", nrow(topn), nm, src))
    print(topn)
    printed_tables[[nm]] <- topn
  }

  # arrange / print plots. If running in non-interactive environment, save PNG as well
  nplots <- length(plot_list)
  ncol_val <- ifelse(nplots == 1, 1, ifelse(nplots == 2, 2, 3))
  # display in R session if interactive
  if (interactive()) {
    do.call(grid.arrange, c(plot_list, ncol = ncol_val))
  }

  # Save combined PNG
  out_file <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "varimp_comparison.png")
  png(out_file, width = 1200, height = 400 * ceiling(nplots / ncol_val))
  do.call(grid.arrange, c(plot_list, ncol = ncol_val))
  dev.off()
  cat("\nSaved variable importance comparison plot to:", out_file, "\n")
}

cat("✓ Variable importance comparison finished.\n")

```

7. Model Comparison Summary
```{r}
# compact_three_model_compare_prefixed_csv.R
# -----------------------------------------
# Robust model comparison helper (prefers per-model CSVs)
# - Looks for files like model_outputs/lr_test_predictions.csv,
#   model_outputs/rf_test_predictions.csv, model_outputs/xgb_test_predictions.csv
# - If not found, falls back to environment variables / model objects
# - Extracts actual / predicted class / positive-class probability robustly
# - Computes metrics (Accuracy, Sensitivity, Specificity, Precision, F1, AUC, Kappa)
# - Saves combined metrics and ROC plot
#
# Usage:
#  - Put your model output CSVs into save_dir (default "model_outputs"), or ensure
#    model/pred objects exist in the environment (lr_model, rf_model, xgb_model, etc).
#  - Run the script.

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(caret)
  library(pROC)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tibble)
  library(stringr)
})

# ---------- CONFIG ----------
save_dir <- "model_outputs"
dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

prefixes <- c("lr", "rf", "xgb")
# preferred CSV file naming pattern example: lr_test_predictions.csv, rf_test_preds.csv, xgb_test_predictions.csv
csv_patterns <- c("test_predictions", "test_preds", "test_predictions_all", "test_prob", "test_probabilities", "predictions")

cat("Save directory:", normalizePath(save_dir), "\n")

# ---------- Helpers ----------
# Strictly prefer CSV whose filename contains the prefix (case-insensitive)
find_prefixed_csv <- function(prefix, dir = save_dir) {
  all_csv <- list.files(dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (length(all_csv) == 0) return(NULL)
  # prefer files that contain the prefix and test/pred keywords
  pattern <- paste0("(?i)", prefix, ".*(", paste(csv_patterns, collapse = "|"), ")\\.csv$")
  matches <- all_csv[grepl(pattern, basename(all_csv), perl = TRUE)]
  if (length(matches) > 0) return(matches[1])
  # fallback: prefer any csv containing prefix
  patt2 <- paste0("(?i)", prefix, ".*\\.csv$")
  matches2 <- all_csv[grepl(patt2, basename(all_csv), perl = TRUE)]
  if (length(matches2) > 0) return(matches2[1])
  # final fallback: try any file with test/pred keywords
  pattern3 <- paste0("(?i)(", paste(csv_patterns, collapse = "|"), ").*\\.csv$")
  matches3 <- all_csv[grepl(pattern3, basename(all_csv), perl = TRUE)]
  if (length(matches3) > 0) return(matches3[1])
  return(NULL)
}

# Robust CSV read and heuristic column selection
read_preds_from_csv <- function(fpath) {
  df <- tryCatch(read.csv(fpath, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)

  cn_low <- tolower(names(df))

  # If the CSV contains multiple models (a Model column), try to select the rows for this model later
  # We will return full df and let caller choose if needed.

  # Heuristics to find actual, predicted class, and prob columns:
  find_col <- function(regex_list) {
    idx <- which(sapply(regex_list, function(rx) grepl(rx, cn_low, perl = TRUE)))
    if (length(idx) > 0) return(names(df)[idx[1]])
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  actual_col <- find_col(c("^actual$","^y$","^label$","^truth$","^target$","^observed$"))
  pred_col   <- find_col(c("pred.*class","predicted","^pred$","^class$","^prediction","^pred$"))
  prob_col   <- find_col(c("prob","probability","pred_prob","repaid_prob","prob_repaid","score"))

  # fallback: if no explicit actual, try a column named "repaid" or "label"
  if (is.na(actual_col)) {
    poss <- which(cn_low %in% c("repaid","label","y"))
    if (length(poss) > 0) actual_col <- names(df)[poss[1]]
  }

  # fallback: if no prob_col and there are exactly 2 numeric columns, prefer second numeric as prob
  if (is.na(prob_col)) {
    nums <- names(df)[sapply(df, is.numeric)]
    if (length(nums) >= 1) {
      # prefer second numeric (often csv contains [actual, prob1, prob2] or [prob_not, prob_repaid])
      prob_col <- if (length(nums) >= 2) nums[2] else nums[1]
    }
  }

  # Make results: return df and column names (may be NA)
  list(df = df, actual_col = actual_col, pred_col = pred_col, prob_col = prob_col, path = fpath)
}

# Extract positive-class probability from various objects (data.frame, vector, matrix)
extract_positive_prob <- function(obj) {
  if (is.null(obj)) return(NULL)
  if (is.numeric(obj) && is.vector(obj)) return(as.numeric(obj))
  if (is.data.frame(obj) || is.matrix(obj)) {
    cn <- colnames(obj)
    if (!is.null(cn) && "Repaid" %in% cn) return(as.numeric(obj[,"Repaid"]))
    # if two columns, assume second is positive class prob
    if (ncol(obj) == 2) return(as.numeric(obj[,2]))
    # choose first numeric column
    nums <- sapply(as.data.frame(obj), is.numeric)
    if (any(nums)) return(as.numeric(obj[, which(nums)[1]]))
  }
  NULL
}

# Main resolver: get predictions for prefix (CSV preferred, then env/model fallback)
get_preds_for_prefix <- function(prefix, save_dir) {
  # 1) Try strict prefixed CSV
  csv_file <- find_prefixed_csv(prefix, save_dir)
  if (!is.null(csv_file)) {
    msg <- paste0("Found CSV for prefix '", prefix, "': ", basename(csv_file))
    message(msg)
    rd <- read_preds_from_csv(csv_file)
    if (is.null(rd)) return(NULL)
    df <- rd$df
    # if CSV contains a Model column, try to filter rows matching prefix (case-insensitive)
    model_col_idx <- which(tolower(names(df)) %in% c("model"))
    if (length(model_col_idx) == 1) {
      model_col <- names(df)[model_col_idx]
      sel <- which(tolower(as.character(df[[model_col]])) %in% c(prefix, paste0(prefix, "_model"), toupper(prefix)))
      if (length(sel) > 0) {
        df_sel <- df[sel, , drop = FALSE]
      } else {
        df_sel <- df
      }
    } else {
      df_sel <- df
    }

    # Try to extract actual, pred, prob using heuristic column names (or fallback)
    actual <- NULL; pred <- NULL; prob <- NULL
    # prefer columns found by reader, else try common names
    if (!is.na(rd$actual_col) && rd$actual_col %in% names(df_sel)) actual <- df_sel[[rd$actual_col]]
    if (!is.na(rd$pred_col)   && rd$pred_col   %in% names(df_sel)) pred   <- df_sel[[rd$pred_col]]
    if (!is.na(rd$prob_col)   && rd$prob_col   %in% names(df_sel)) prob   <- extract_positive_prob(df_sel[[rd$prob_col]])

    # further fallback: if the df has columns named exactly "actual" / "pred" / "prob_repaid" etc.
    if (is.null(actual)) {
      cands <- c("actual","y","label","target","repaid")
      actual <- NULL
      for (c in cands) if (c %in% tolower(names(df_sel))) { actual <- df_sel[[names(df_sel)[which(tolower(names(df_sel))==c)[1]]]]; break }
    }
    if (is.null(pred)) {
      cands <- c("pred","pred_class","predicted","prediction","class")
      for (c in cands) {
        idx <- which(tolower(names(df_sel))==c)
        if (length(idx)>0) { pred <- df_sel[[names(df_sel)[idx[1]]]]; break }
      }
    }
    if (is.null(prob)) {
      cands <- which(sapply(names(df_sel), function(n) grepl("prob|score|probability", tolower(n))))
      if (length(cands)>0) prob <- extract_positive_prob(df_sel[[names(df_sel)[cands[1]]]])
    }

    # if still null, try numeric columns heuristics
    if (is.null(prob)) {
      nums <- names(df_sel)[sapply(df_sel, is.numeric)]
      if (length(nums) >= 1) prob <- extract_positive_prob(df_sel[[nums[min(2, length(nums))]]])
    }

    return(list(from = "csv", actual = actual, pred = pred, prob = prob, path = csv_file))
  } # end csv branch

  # 2) Fallback: environment variables
  message("No prefixed CSV for '", prefix, "'; trying environment variables / model objects...")

  # try common variable names
  cls_names  <- c(paste0(prefix, "_pred_class"), paste0(prefix, "_pred"), paste0(prefix, "_predictions"), paste0(prefix, "_pred_class_test"))
  prob_names <- c(paste0(prefix, "_pred_prob"), paste0(prefix, "_pred_probs"), paste0(prefix, "_prob"), paste0(prefix, "_pred_proba"))
  model_names <- c(paste0(prefix, "_model"), paste0(prefix, "_fit"), prefix, paste0(prefix, "model"))

  cls_obj <- NULL; prob_obj <- NULL; actual_obj <- NULL
  for (n in cls_names) if (exists(n, envir = .GlobalEnv)) { cls_obj <- get(n, envir = .GlobalEnv); break }
  for (n in prob_names) if (exists(n, envir = .GlobalEnv)) { prob_obj <- get(n, envir = .GlobalEnv); break }
  # actual: try common test_data objects
  if (exists("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    td <- get("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)
    if ("repaid" %in% names(td)) actual_obj <- td$repaid
  }
  if (is.null(actual_obj) && exists("test", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    td2 <- get("test", envir = .GlobalEnv)
    if ("repaid" %in% names(td2)) actual_obj <- td2$repaid
  }

  # If pred/prob missing but model exists and test_data exists, try predict()
  if ((is.null(cls_obj) || is.null(prob_obj)) && exists("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    td <- get("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)
    for (mn in model_names) {
      if (exists(mn, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
        m <- get(mn, envir = .GlobalEnv)
        # caret::train
        if (inherits(m, "train")) {
          if (is.null(cls_obj)) {
            try({ cls_obj <- predict(m, td, type = "raw") }, silent = TRUE)
          }
          if (is.null(prob_obj)) {
            try({ prb <- predict(m, td, type = "prob"); prob_obj <- extract_positive_prob(prb) }, silent = TRUE)
          }
        } else if (inherits(m, "xgb.Booster") || inherits(m, "xgb.Booster.handle")) {
          # try to build matrix and predict
          try({
            tdf <- if ("repaid" %in% names(td)) td %>% select(-repaid) else td
            X_test <- tryCatch(sparse.model.matrix(~ . -1, data = tdf), error = function(e) NULL)
            if (!is.null(X_test)) {
              prob_try <- tryCatch(predict(m, X_test), error = function(e) NULL)
              if (!is.null(prob_try)) prob_obj <- prob_try
              if (is.null(cls_obj) && !is.null(prob_obj)) cls_obj <- ifelse(prob_obj >= 0.5, "Repaid", "Not_Repaid")
            }
          }, silent = TRUE)
        } else {
          # generic predict fallback
          try({
            if (is.null(cls_obj)) {
              pr <- tryCatch(predict(m, td, type = "raw"), error = function(e) NULL)
              if (!is.null(pr)) cls_obj <- pr
            }
            if (is.null(prob_obj)) {
              prb <- tryCatch(predict(m, td, type = "prob"), error = function(e) NULL)
              if (!is.null(prb)) prob_obj <- extract_positive_prob(prb)
            }
          }, silent = TRUE)
        }
      } # if exists mn
      if (!is.null(cls_obj) || !is.null(prob_obj)) break
    } # for models
  } # if test_data exists

  # finally return whatever found
  prob_v <- extract_positive_prob(prob_obj)
  list(from = "env", actual = actual_obj, pred = cls_obj, prob = prob_v)
}

# Compute metrics robustly - returns tibble row
compute_metrics <- function(actual_raw, pred_raw = NULL, prob_raw = NULL, model_name = "model") {
  # normalize actual to factor (Not_Repaid, Repaid)
  norm_lbl <- function(x) {
    if (is.null(x)) return(factor(character(0), levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid")))
    xc <- tolower(as.character(x))
    xc[xc %in% c("1","true","yes","repaid","y","t")] <- "Repaid"
    xc[xc %in% c("0","false","no","not_repaid","n","notrepaid")] <- "Not_Repaid"
    factor(ifelse(xc == "Repaid","Repaid", ifelse(xc == "Not_Repaid","Not_Repaid", NA)),
           levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
  }

  actual_f <- norm_lbl(actual_raw)
  if (length(actual_f) == 0) stop("Empty actuals for model: ", model_name)

  # derive pred if missing but probability provided
  if (is.null(pred_raw) && !is.null(prob_raw) && is.numeric(prob_raw) && length(prob_raw) == length(actual_f)) {
    pred_f <- factor(ifelse(as.numeric(prob_raw) >= 0.5, "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"), levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
  } else if (!is.null(pred_raw)) {
    pred_f <- norm_lbl(pred_raw)
  } else pred_f <- NULL

  # length checks
  if (!is.null(pred_f) && length(pred_f) != length(actual_f)) pred_f <- NULL
  if (!is.null(prob_raw) && length(prob_raw) != length(actual_f)) prob_raw <- NULL

  cm <- NULL
  roc_obj <- NULL
  auc_val <- NA_real_

  if (!is.null(pred_f)) {
    cm <- tryCatch(confusionMatrix(pred_f, actual_f, positive = "Repaid"), error = function(e) NULL)
  }

  if (!is.null(prob_raw)) {
    roc_obj <- tryCatch(pROC::roc(response = as.numeric(actual_f == "Repaid"), predictor = as.numeric(prob_raw), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(roc_obj)) auc_val <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj))
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    Model = model_name,
    Accuracy = if (!is.null(cm)) as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"]) else NA_real_,
    Sensitivity = if (!is.null(cm)) as.numeric(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]) else NA_real_,
    Specificity = if (!is.null(cm)) as.numeric(cm$byClass["Specificity"]) else NA_real_,
    Precision = if (!is.null(cm)) as.numeric(cm$byClass["Precision"]) else NA_real_,
    F1_Score = if (!is.null(cm)) as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"]) else NA_real_,
    AUC = auc_val,
    Kappa = if (!is.null(cm)) as.numeric(cm$overall["Kappa"]) else NA_real_
  )
}

# ---------- Main loop: gather preds and metrics ----------
results_list <- list()
roc_objs <- list()

for (pref in prefixes) {
  message("\n--- Processing prefix: ", pref, " ---")
  info <- get_preds_for_prefix(pref, save_dir)
  if (is.null(info)) {
    message("  No information found for ", pref)
    next
  }
  # actual: prefer info$actual else global test/test_data
  actual_v <- info$actual
  if (is.null(actual_v) || length(actual_v) == 0) {
    if (exists("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)) actual_v <- get("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)$repaid
    else if (exists("test", envir = .GlobalEnv)) actual_v <- get("test", envir = .GlobalEnv)$repaid
  }
  if (is.null(actual_v) || length(actual_v) == 0) {
    message("  No actual labels for ", pref, " -> skipping")
    next
  }

  # get pred & prob
  pred_v <- info$pred
  prob_v <- info$prob

  # If CSV returned full dataframe and columns exist, try to re-extract with educated guesses
  if (info$from == "csv" && !is.null(info$path)) {
    rd <- read_preds_from_csv(info$path)
    df <- rd$df
    # if df has a single row per observation and actual/pred/prob columns present, try to extract
    # Use the first matching column heuristics
    # actual
    if (is.null(actual_v) || length(actual_v) == 0) {
      ac <- rd$actual_col
      if (!is.na(ac) && ac %in% names(df)) actual_v <- df[[ac]]
    }
    # pred
    if (is.null(pred_v) || length(pred_v) == 0) {
      pc <- rd$pred_col
      if (!is.na(pc) && pc %in% names(df)) pred_v <- df[[pc]]
    }
    # prob
    if (is.null(prob_v) || length(prob_v) == 0) {
      pb <- rd$prob_col
      if (!is.na(pb) && pb %in% names(df)) prob_v <- extract_positive_prob(df[[pb]])
      # fallback to numeric heuristics
      if (is.null(prob_v) || length(prob_v) == 0) {
        nums <- names(df)[sapply(df, is.numeric)]
        if (length(nums) >= 1) prob_v <- extract_positive_prob(df[[nums[min(2,length(nums))]]])
      }
    }
  }

  # compute metrics
  res_tbl <- tryCatch(compute_metrics(actual_v, pred_v, prob_v, toupper(pref)), error = function(e) {
    message("  compute error for ", pref, ": ", e$message)
    NULL
  })
  if (is.null(res_tbl)) next
  results_list[[toupper(pref)]] <- res_tbl

  # collect roc object for plotting if we have a matching prob vector
  if (!is.null(prob_v) && length(prob_v) == length(actual_v)) {
    actual_f <- factor(tolower(as.character(actual_v)))
    # build roc using normalized actuals (Repaid vs Not_Repaid)
    actual_norm <- ifelse(tolower(as.character(actual_v)) %in% c("1","true","yes","repaid","y"), 1, 0)
    roc_o <- tryCatch(pROC::roc(response = actual_norm, predictor = as.numeric(prob_v), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(roc_o)) roc_objs[[toupper(pref)]] <- roc_o
  }
  message("  collected metrics for ", pref)
}

if (length(results_list) == 0) stop("No model results collected. Ensure predictions CSVs in '", save_dir, "' or predictions exist in the environment.")

metrics_tbl <- bind_rows(results_list) %>% arrange(desc(AUC))
print(metrics_tbl)

# save csv
out_metrics_csv <- file.path(save_dir, "models_comparison_metrics_prefixed.csv")
write.csv(metrics_tbl, out_metrics_csv, row.names = FALSE)
message("Saved metrics CSV -> ", out_metrics_csv)

# Combined ROC plot (if any)
if (length(roc_objs) > 0) {
  roc_df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(roc_objs), function(nm) {
    r <- roc_objs[[nm]]
    data.frame(model = nm, fpr = 1 - r$specificities, tpr = r$sensitivities, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }), .id = NULL)
  p <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(x = fpr, y = tpr, color = model)) +
    geom_line(size = 1) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    labs(x = "False Positive Rate", y = "True Positive Rate", title = "ROC Curves - Model Comparison") +
    theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  print(p)
  ggsave(file.path(save_dir, "models_combined_roc_prefixed.png"), plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 150)
  message("Saved ROC plot -> ", file.path(save_dir, "models_combined_roc_prefixed.png"))
} else {
  message("No ROC curves (no probability vectors found).")
}

message("\nDone. Outputs in: ", normalizePath(save_dir))


```

8. Final Visualizations
8.1 Performance Metrics Comparison Plot

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# Performance Metrics Comparison Visualization (robust)
# ============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# --- locate metrics table ---
metrics_source <- NULL
if (exists("all_metrics", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
  metrics_source <- get("all_metrics", envir = .GlobalEnv)
} else if (exists("metrics_tbl", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
  metrics_source <- get("metrics_tbl", envir = .GlobalEnv)
} else if (exists("metrics_df", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
  metrics_source <- get("metrics_df", envir = .GlobalEnv)
} else if (file.exists(file.path("model_outputs", "models_comparison_metrics.csv"))) {
  metrics_source <- tryCatch(read.csv(file.path("model_outputs", "models_comparison_metrics.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
                             error = function(e) NULL)
}

if (is.null(metrics_source) || nrow(metrics_source) == 0) {
  stop("No metrics table found: please provide an object named 'all_metrics' or 'metrics_tbl', or the CSV model_outputs/models_comparison_metrics.csv")
}

# ensure it's a data.frame / tibble
metrics_tbl <- as.data.frame(metrics_source, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# normalize column names and required columns
names(metrics_tbl) <- make.names(names(metrics_tbl))
required_cols <- c("Model", "Accuracy", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "Precision", "F1_Score", "AUC")
present <- intersect(required_cols, names(metrics_tbl))
if (!"Model" %in% names(metrics_tbl)) {
  # try to convert rownames to Model column
  if (!is.null(rownames(metrics_tbl))) {
    metrics_tbl <- tibble::rownames_to_column(metrics_tbl, var = "Model")
  } else {
    stop("Metrics table has no 'Model' column and no rownames to recover.")
  }
  names(metrics_tbl) <- make.names(names(metrics_tbl))
}

# Coerce metric columns to numeric when possible, keep missing as NA
for (col in setdiff(required_cols, "Model")) {
  if (col %in% names(metrics_tbl)) {
    metrics_tbl[[col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(metrics_tbl[[col]])))
  } else {
    metrics_tbl[[col]] <- NA_real_
  }
}

# select just Model + metrics of interest
plot_metrics <- metrics_tbl %>%
  dplyr::select(Model, Accuracy, Sensitivity, Specificity, Precision, F1_Score, AUC)

# reshape to long; preserve model order as in table
metrics_long <- plot_metrics %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -Model, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value")

# ensure Metric is an ordered factor (common order)
metric_levels <- c("Accuracy","Sensitivity","Specificity","Precision","F1_Score","AUC")
metrics_long$Metric <- factor(metrics_long$Metric, levels = metric_levels)

# remove completely NA rows (for plotting only)
plot_df <- metrics_long %>% filter(!is.na(Value))

if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
  stop("No numeric metric values available to plot.")
}

# compute max value to set y limit reasonably (cap at 1.05)
max_val <- min(1.05, max(plot_df$Value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1)

# Create comparison plot
p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Metric, y = Value, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.9, colour = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#e74c3c", "#3498db", "#2ecc71"), na.value = "gray50") +
  labs(
    title = "Model Performance Metrics Comparison",
    subtitle = "Comparison across key evaluation metrics",
    x = "Metric",
    y = "Value",
    fill = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(Value), "", sprintf("%.3f", Value))),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max_val), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02)))

# print and (optionally) save
print(p)
if (dir.exists("model_outputs")) {
  ggsave(filename = file.path("model_outputs", "model_metrics_comparison.png"), plot = p, width = 9, height = 5)
  message("Saved plot to model_outputs/model_metrics_comparison.png")
} else {
  message("model_outputs directory not found; plot not saved.")
}
```

8.2 Confusion Matrix Heatmaps
```{r}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build evaluation objects (logit_eval, rf_eval, xgb_eval) and then plot/save
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  required <- c("caret","pROC","ggplot2","gridExtra")
  for (pk in required) if (!requireNamespace(pk, quietly = TRUE)) stop(sprintf("Please install package: %s", pk))
  library(caret); library(pROC); library(ggplot2); library(gridExtra)
})

# Helper: normalize labels to factor with levels c("Not_Repaid","Repaid")
norm_labels <- function(x) {
  x_chr <- tolower(as.character(x))
  x_chr[x_chr %in% c("1","true","yes","y","repaid","paid")] <- "Repaid"
  x_chr[x_chr %in% c("0","false","no","n","notrepaid","not_repaid","not repaid")] <- "Not_Repaid"
  res <- ifelse(x_chr == "Repaid", "Repaid", ifelse(x_chr == "Not_Repaid", "Not_Repaid", NA_character_))
  factor(res, levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
}

# Helper: try to extract positive-class probability from object returned by predict(...)
extract_prob <- function(obj) {
  if (is.null(obj)) return(NULL)
  if (is.numeric(obj) && is.vector(obj)) return(as.numeric(obj))
  if (is.data.frame(obj) || is.matrix(obj)) {
    cn <- colnames(obj)
    if (!is.null(cn) && "Repaid" %in% cn) return(as.numeric(obj[,"Repaid"]))
    if (ncol(obj) == 2) return(as.numeric(obj[,2]))
    # fallback: first numeric column
    numcols <- sapply(as.data.frame(obj), is.numeric)
    if (any(numcols)) return(as.numeric(obj[, which(numcols)[1]]))
  }
  NULL
}

# Try to obtain predictions for a single prefix
build_eval_for_prefix <- function(prefix, test_df = NULL) {
  # returns list(cm = confusionMatrix, roc = roc_obj, pred = pred_class, prob = prob_vec, actual = actual)
  cls_names  <- c(paste0(prefix, "_pred_class"), paste0(prefix, "_pred"), paste0(prefix, "_predictions"), paste0(prefix, "_preds"))
  prob_names <- c(paste0(prefix, "_pred_prob"), paste0(prefix, "_pred_probs"), paste0(prefix, "_prob"))
  model_names <- c(paste0(prefix, "_fit"), paste0(prefix, "_model"), paste0(prefix, "model"), prefix)
  # also common alternatives
  if (prefix == "lr") model_names <- c(model_names, "lr_fit", "lr_model", "glm_fit")
  if (prefix == "rf") model_names <- c(model_names, "rf_fit", "rf_model", "randomForest_model")
  if (prefix == "xgb") model_names <- c(model_names, "xgb_model", "xgb_fit", "xgb")
  
  # find existing prediction objects in global env
  pred_class_obj <- NULL; pred_prob_obj <- NULL
  for (n in cls_names) if (exists(n, envir = .GlobalEnv)) { pred_class_obj <- get(n, envir = .GlobalEnv); break }
  for (n in prob_names) if (exists(n, envir = .GlobalEnv)) { pred_prob_obj  <- get(n, envir = .GlobalEnv); break }

  # find test data if not provided
  if (is.null(test_df)) {
    if (exists("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)) test_df <- get("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)
    else if (exists("test", envir = .GlobalEnv)) test_df <- get("test", envir = .GlobalEnv)
    else if (exists("data_test", envir = .GlobalEnv)) test_df <- get("data_test", envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }

  # actual vector
  actual_v <- NULL
  if (!is.null(test_df) && "repaid" %in% colnames(test_df)) actual_v <- test_df$repaid

  # If preds missing, try to predict from a model in env
  if ((is.null(pred_class_obj) || is.null(pred_prob_obj)) && !is.null(test_df)) {
    for (mn in model_names) {
      if (exists(mn, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
        m <- get(mn, envir = .GlobalEnv)
        # caret::train object
        if (inherits(m, "train")) {
          if (is.null(pred_class_obj)) {
            try({ pred_class_obj <- predict(m, newdata = test_df, type = "raw") }, silent = TRUE)
          }
          if (is.null(pred_prob_obj)) {
            try({ pred_prob_obj <- tryCatch(predict(m, newdata = test_df, type = "prob"), error = function(e) NULL) }, silent = TRUE)
          }
        } else {
          # try generic predict: raw and prob
          if (is.null(pred_class_obj)) {
            try({ pr <- tryCatch(predict(m, test_df), error = function(e) NULL); if (!is.null(pr)) pred_class_obj <- pr }, silent = TRUE)
          }
          if (is.null(pred_prob_obj)) {
            # xgboost native booster
            if (inherits(m, "xgb.Booster") || inherits(m, "xgb.Booster.handle")) {
              try({
                tdf <- if ("repaid" %in% colnames(test_df)) subset(test_df, select = -repaid) else test_df
                X_test <- tryCatch(Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ . -1, data = tdf), error = function(e) NULL)
                if (!is.null(X_test)) pred_prob_obj <- tryCatch(predict(m, X_test), error = function(e) NULL)
              }, silent = TRUE)
            } else {
              try({ prb <- tryCatch(predict(m, test_df, type = "prob"), error = function(e) NULL); if (!is.null(prb)) pred_prob_obj <- prb }, silent = TRUE)
            }
          }
        }
      }
      if (!is.null(pred_class_obj) || !is.null(pred_prob_obj)) break
    }
  }

  # finalize actual vector normalized
  if (!is.null(actual_v)) {
    actual_f <- norm_labels(actual_v)
  } else {
    actual_f <- NULL
  }

  # get class vector (character/factor)
  pred_class_vec <- NULL
  if (!is.null(pred_class_obj)) {
    if (is.factor(pred_class_obj)) pred_class_vec <- as.character(pred_class_obj)
    else pred_class_vec <- as.character(pred_class_obj)
  }

  # get prob vector for positive class
  pred_prob_vec <- extract_prob(pred_prob_obj)

  # if pred_class missing and prob available, derive class via 0.5
  if (is.null(pred_class_vec) && !is.null(pred_prob_vec) && !is.null(actual_f) && length(pred_prob_vec) == length(actual_f)) {
    pred_class_vec <- ifelse(as.numeric(pred_prob_vec) >= 0.5, "Repaid", "Not_Repaid")
  }

  # normalize pred_class to factor with same levels
  pred_f <- if (!is.null(pred_class_vec)) norm_labels(pred_class_vec) else NULL

  # compute confusionMatrix if possible
  cm_obj <- NULL
  roc_obj <- NULL
  if (!is.null(pred_f) && !is.null(actual_f) && length(pred_f) == length(actual_f)) {
    cm_try <- tryCatch(confusionMatrix(pred_f, actual_f, positive = "Repaid"), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(cm_try)) cm_obj <- cm_try
  }

  # ROC if prob_vec available and actual present
  if (!is.null(pred_prob_vec) && !is.null(actual_f) && length(pred_prob_vec) == length(actual_f)) {
    roc_try <- tryCatch(roc(response = as.numeric(actual_f == "Repaid"), predictor = as.numeric(pred_prob_vec), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(roc_try)) roc_obj <- roc_try
  }

  list(cm = cm_obj, roc = roc_obj, pred = pred_f, prob = pred_prob_vec, actual = actual_f)
}

# Build evals for lr/rf/xgb and save to global env for plotting code to pick up
prefixes <- c(lr = "lr", rf = "rf", xgb = "xgb")
for (p in prefixes) {
  message(sprintf("Building evaluation for prefix '%s' ...", p))
  eval_res <- build_eval_for_prefix(p)
  # name in global env: logit_eval for lr, rf_eval, xgb_eval
  name_out <- if (p == "lr") "logit_eval" else paste0(p, "_eval")
  assign(name_out, eval_res, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  if (!is.null(eval_res$cm)) {
    message(sprintf("  -> %s: confusion matrix computed (rows=%d, cols=%d)", name_out, nrow(eval_res$cm$table), ncol(eval_res$cm$table)))
  } else {
    message(sprintf("  -> %s: no confusion matrix (preds or actuals missing).", name_out))
  }
  if (!is.null(eval_res$roc)) {
    message(sprintf("  -> %s: ROC computed (AUC=%.4f)", name_out, as.numeric(auc(eval_res$roc))))
  } else {
    message(sprintf("  -> %s: no ROC (probabilities missing or mismatch).", name_out))
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Now plot confusion matrices robustly (re-uses make_cm_plot logic)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# helper to extract cm dataframe from list created above
cm_list_to_df <- function(eval_obj) {
  if (is.null(eval_obj)) return(NULL)
  if (!is.null(eval_obj$cm) && inherits(eval_obj$cm, "confusionMatrix")) {
    df <- as.data.frame(eval_obj$cm$table)
    # ensure columns Prediction, Reference, Freq (caret's as.data.frame returns Prediction/Reference/Freq)
    names(df) <- c("Prediction", "Reference", "Freq")
    return(df)
  }
  # if there's a raw table in eval_obj$confusion try that
  if (!is.null(eval_obj$confusion) && (is.matrix(eval_obj$confusion) || inherits(eval_obj$confusion, "table"))) {
    df <- as.data.frame(as.table(eval_obj$confusion))
    names(df) <- c("Prediction","Reference","Freq")
    return(df)
  }
  return(NULL)
}

# make plot function
make_cm_plot_simple <- function(cm_df, title) {
  cm_df$Prediction <- factor(as.character(cm_df$Prediction), levels = unique(cm_df$Prediction))
  cm_df$Reference  <- factor(as.character(cm_df$Reference), levels = unique(cm_df$Reference))
  ggplot(cm_df, aes(x = Reference, y = Prediction, fill = Freq)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = Freq), size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#3498db", na.value = "grey90") +
    labs(title = title, x = "Actual", y = "Predicted") +
    theme_minimal() + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
}

plots <- list()
if (exists("logit_eval", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
  dfcm <- cm_list_to_df(get("logit_eval", envir = .GlobalEnv))
  if (!is.null(dfcm)) plots[["Logistic Regression"]] <- make_cm_plot_simple(dfcm, "Logistic Regression")
}
if (exists("rf_eval", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
  dfcm <- cm_list_to_df(get("rf_eval", envir = .GlobalEnv))
  if (!is.null(dfcm)) plots[["Random Forest"]] <- make_cm_plot_simple(dfcm, "Random Forest")
}
if (exists("xgb_eval", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
  dfcm <- cm_list_to_df(get("xgb_eval", envir = .GlobalEnv))
  if (!is.null(dfcm)) plots[["XGBoost"]] <- make_cm_plot_simple(dfcm, "XGBoost")
}

if (length(plots) == 0) {
  stop("No confusion matrices found after evaluation building. Ensure you have test labels and either saved predictions or model objects to predict from.")
}

# display on screen and save PNG to model_outputs if present
ncol_val <- min(3, length(plots))
grid.arrange(grobs = plots, ncol = ncol_val)

out_dir <- if (dir.exists("model_outputs")) "model_outputs" else getwd()
out_file <- file.path(out_dir, "confusion_matrices_combined.png")
png(out_file, width = 1200, height = 400 * ceiling(length(plots)/ncol_val))
grid.arrange(grobs = plots, ncol = ncol_val)
dev.off()
message("Saved combined confusion matrices PNG to: ", normalizePath(out_file))

```

9. Conclusions
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# Final Conclusions (robust & defensive)
# ============================================================================

# Print a robust "final conclusions" summary using whatever objects are available.
# This will not error if some variables (data_transformed, selected_features, all_metrics, etc.)
# are missing. It will attempt reasonable fallbacks.

cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 70), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")
cat("FINAL CONCLUSIONS\n")
cat(paste(rep("=", 70), collapse = ""), "\n\n", sep = "")

# -----------------------
# 1) Dataset / Split summary
# -----------------------
# prefer data_transformed, else data, else try to construct from train/test
data_obj <- NULL
if (exists("data_transformed", envir = .GlobalEnv) && is.data.frame(get("data_transformed", envir = .GlobalEnv))) {
  data_obj <- get("data_transformed", envir = .GlobalEnv)
  data_name <- "data_transformed"
} else if (exists("data", envir = .GlobalEnv) && is.data.frame(get("data", envir = .GlobalEnv))) {
  data_obj <- get("data", envir = .GlobalEnv)
  data_name <- "data"
} else {
  data_obj <- NULL
  data_name <- NA_character_
}

# Train/test counts: prefer train_data/test_data, else train/test, else attempt to infer from indices in data
train_exists <- exists("train_data", envir = .GlobalEnv) && is.data.frame(get("train_data", envir = .GlobalEnv))
test_exists  <- exists("test_data",  envir = .GlobalEnv) && is.data.frame(get("test_data",  envir = .GlobalEnv))
if (!train_exists) train_exists <- exists("train", envir = .GlobalEnv) && is.data.frame(get("train", envir = .GlobalEnv))
if (!test_exists)  test_exists  <- exists("test",  envir = .GlobalEnv) && is.data.frame(get("test",  envir = .GlobalEnv))

train_df <- if (exists("train_data", envir = .GlobalEnv) && is.data.frame(get("train_data", envir = .GlobalEnv))) get("train_data", envir = .GlobalEnv) else if (exists("train", envir = .GlobalEnv) && is.data.frame(get("train", envir = .GlobalEnv)) ) get("train", envir = .GlobalEnv) else NULL
test_df  <- if (exists("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv) && is.data.frame(get("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv))) get("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv) else if (exists("test", envir = .GlobalEnv) && is.data.frame(get("test", envir = .GlobalEnv)) ) get("test", envir = .GlobalEnv) else NULL

total_obs <- if (!is.null(data_obj)) nrow(data_obj) else if (!is.null(train_df) && !is.null(test_df)) (nrow(train_df) + nrow(test_df)) else NA_integer_
train_n <- if (!is.null(train_df)) nrow(train_df) else NA_integer_
test_n  <- if (!is.null(test_df))  nrow(test_df)  else NA_integer_

cat("1. DATASET SUMMARY\n")
if (!is.na(total_obs)) {
  cat(sprintf("   • Source dataset: %s\n", ifelse(!is.na(data_name), data_name, "in-memory / inferred")))
  cat(sprintf("   • Total observations: %d\n", total_obs))
} else {
  cat("   • Total observations: (unknown — no data/data_transformed/train+test found)\n")
}
if (!is.na(train_n) && !is.na(train_n) && !is.na(test_n) && !is.na(test_n)) {
  pct_train <- 100 * train_n / (train_n + test_n)
  pct_test  <- 100 * test_n  / (train_n + test_n)
  cat(sprintf("   • Training set: %d (%.1f%%)\n", train_n, pct_train))
  cat(sprintf("   • Test set:     %d (%.1f%%)\n", test_n, pct_test))
} else {
  if (!is.na(train_n)) cat(sprintf("   • Training set: %d\n", train_n)) else cat("   • Training set: (not available)\n")
  if (!is.na(test_n))  cat(sprintf("   • Test set:     %d\n", test_n))  else cat("   • Test set:     (not available)\n")
}

# -----------------------
# 2) Features used
# -----------------------
# prefer selected_features variable, else infer from train_df (exclude 'repaid' and prediction columns)
selected_feats <- NULL
if (exists("selected_features", envir = .GlobalEnv) && (is.vector(get("selected_features", envir = .GlobalEnv)) || is.character(get("selected_features", envir = .GlobalEnv)))) {
  selected_feats <- as.character(get("selected_features", envir = .GlobalEnv))
} else if (!is.null(train_df)) {
  # infer: predictors in train_df excluding repaid and common meta columns
  cand <- setdiff(names(train_df), c("repaid", "pred_class", "prob_Repaid", "pred_prob", "pred"))
  if (length(cand) > 0) selected_feats <- cand
} else if (!is.null(data_obj)) {
  cand <- setdiff(names(data_obj), c("repaid", "pred_class", "prob_Repaid", "pred_prob", "pred"))
  if (length(cand) > 0) selected_feats <- cand
}

if (!is.null(selected_feats)) {
  cat("\n   • Features used (count): ", length(selected_feats), "\n", sep = "")
  # print a compact list (max 50 chars per line)
  pretty_feats <- paste(selected_feats, collapse = ", ")
  if (nchar(pretty_feats) > 300) {
    cat("     - ", substr(pretty_feats, 1, 300), "..., (truncated)\n", sep = "")
  } else {
    cat("     - ", pretty_feats, "\n", sep = "")
  }
} else {
  cat("\n   • Features used: (could not determine selected features)\n")
}

# Optional: list excluded features if variable exists
if (exists("excluded_features", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
  exf <- get("excluded_features", envir = .GlobalEnv)
  if (length(exf) > 0) cat(sprintf("   • Excluded features: %s\n", paste(exf, collapse = ", ")))
} else {
  # keep your original comment but do not fail
  # you previously mentioned some excluded fields — only print if present
  if (exists("driver_tenure", envir = .GlobalEnv) || exists("size_of_downpayment", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    cat("   • Note: some features such as driver_tenure or size_of_downpayment may have been excluded.\n")
  }
}

# -----------------------
# 3) Model performance summary
# -----------------------
cat("\n2. MODEL PERFORMANCE SUMMARY\n")

# Try to find an 'all_metrics' table or similar; check common names then fallback to metrics files
metrics_obj <- NULL
if (exists("all_metrics", envir = .GlobalEnv) && is.data.frame(get("all_metrics", envir = .GlobalEnv))) {
  metrics_obj <- get("all_metrics", envir = .GlobalEnv)
} else if (exists("metrics_tbl", envir = .GlobalEnv) && is.data.frame(get("metrics_tbl", envir = .GlobalEnv))) {
  metrics_obj <- get("metrics_tbl", envir = .GlobalEnv)
} else if (exists("metrics_summary", envir = .GlobalEnv) && is.data.frame(get("metrics_summary", envir = .GlobalEnv))) {
  metrics_obj <- get("metrics_summary", envir = .GlobalEnv)
} else {
  # try to read saved csv in model_outputs or save_dir
  try({
    if (file.exists(file.path("model_outputs", "models_comparison_metrics.csv"))) {
      metrics_obj <- read.csv(file.path("model_outputs", "models_comparison_metrics.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    } else if (file.exists("model_comparison_summary.csv")) {
      metrics_obj <- read.csv("model_comparison_summary.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }
  }, silent = TRUE)
}

if (is.null(metrics_obj) || nrow(metrics_obj) == 0) {
  cat("   • No metrics table (all_metrics / metrics_tbl / metrics_summary) found in environment or model_outputs.\n")
  cat("     Please run the model evaluation stage to produce 'all_metrics' or check 'model_outputs'.\n")
} else {
  # Normalize column names
  colnames(metrics_obj) <- make.names(colnames(metrics_obj))
  # prefer columns named Accuracy, AUC, F1_Score
  required_cols <- c("Model","Accuracy","AUC","F1_Score")
  # if Model missing try rownames to column
  if (!"Model" %in% colnames(metrics_obj)) {
    metrics_obj <- tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(metrics_obj), "Model")
  }
  # print table (compact)
  print_cols <- intersect(c("Model","Accuracy","Sensitivity","Specificity","Precision","F1_Score","AUC"), colnames(metrics_obj))
  if (length(print_cols) == 0) {
    cat("   • Metrics table found but contains no known metric columns.\n")
  } else {
    cat("   • Summary of available metrics:\n")
    # round numeric columns for printing
    disp <- metrics_obj
    for (c in print_cols) {
      if (is.numeric(disp[[c]])) disp[[c]] <- round(disp[[c]], 4)
    }
    print(disp[, print_cols, drop = FALSE], row.names = FALSE)
  }

  # Best model by AUC (if AUC exists)
  if ("AUC" %in% colnames(metrics_obj) && any(!is.na(as.numeric(metrics_obj$AUC)))) {
    # coerce to numeric safely
    aucs <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(metrics_obj$AUC)))
    best_idx <- which.max(aucs)
    if (length(best_idx) == 1 && !is.na(aucs[best_idx])) {
      cat(sprintf("\n   • Best overall model by AUC: %s (AUC = %.4f)\n", metrics_obj$Model[best_idx], aucs[best_idx]))
    }
  }
}

# -----------------------
# 4) Key findings & recommendations (generic if metrics absent)
# -----------------------

if (!is.null(metrics_obj) && nrow(metrics_obj) > 0) {
  cat("   • Models were evaluated using standard metrics (Accuracy, AUC, F1, etc.).\n")
  cat("   • Review the printed metrics above to see model trade-offs (sensitivity vs specificity).\n")
} else {

}

cat("   • Investigate high-importance features (from varImp) for data quality issues or drift.\n")

# -----------------------
# 5) Save a short summary CSV if metrics exist
# -----------------------

  out_summary <- tryCatch({
    out_csv <- file.path(ifelse(dir.exists("model_outputs"), "model_outputs", "."), "final_conclusions_metrics_snapshot.csv")
    write.csv(metrics_obj, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)
    out_csv
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(out_summary)) cat("\nSaved metrics snapshot to:", normalizePath(out_summary), "\n")
}

cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 70), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")
cat("✓ Analysis complete\n")
cat(paste(rep("=", 70), collapse = ""), "\n\n", sep = "")
```
